generic.Defined scope/population: All Tier 1 and Tier 2 broker partners due a QBR in the current quarter per the tier cadence.
generic.In-scope period: The review quarter just closed, with production and loss data cut at quarter end.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Meeting date, attendee list, partner principal, minutes link and commitments are all recorded in CRM.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: QBRs held in the quarter equal the count of partners whose tier cadence required one.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed-off minutes and the QBR pack version are filed on the partner record within 5 business days.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any missed or deferred QBR is logged with reason, revised date and Head of Distribution acceptance.
generic.Test population: Every partner with a QBR obligation in the review quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any obligated partner has no completed QBR activity with attendees and minutes attached.
generic.Exception handling path: Deferred QBRs are rebooked within 20 business days and escalated to the Head of Distribution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: QBR is accepted when minutes, attendees and partner commitments are filed on the partner record.
generic.Evidence location: CRM partner account activity record plus the QBR pack in the partner document folder.

steps.title: Confirm QBR cadence obligation on the partner record in CRM
sop: Open the partner account in CRM and read the assigned tier and review cadence fields.
Confirm the meeting date being held falls inside the quarter the cadence requires.
Flag any partner whose last QBR date breaches the cadence to the Head of Distribution.
Done when the cadence obligation for this QBR is confirmed on the partner record.
verify: Re-read the cadence field and the scheduled QBR date on the CRM partner account.
Pass when the QBR date sits inside the cadence window set by the partner tier.

steps.title: Open the QBR and capture the attendee list in CRM
sop: Start the Microsoft Teams meeting at the booked time and confirm the partner principal is present.
Record each attendee name, organisation and role in the CRM meeting activity.
Note the internal relationship owner explicitly against the activity.
Done when the attendee list including the partner principal is saved on the CRM activity.
verify: Open the CRM meeting activity and read the attendee list.
Pass when the partner principal and the internal relationship owner both appear as attendees.

steps.title: Walk the production versus plan pages of the QBR pack from the BI platform
sop: Share the BI reporting platform production-versus-plan page for the review quarter.
Step through written premium, new business and submission counts against the agreed plan.
Record the partner explanation for any material variance in the meeting note.
Done when production versus plan has been presented and the partner response captured.
verify: Check the QBR pack contains the production-versus-plan page for the review quarter.
Pass when production-versus-plan figures for the review quarter are present in the pack.

steps.title: Present loss ratio and retention results from the BI reporting platform
sop: Display the loss ratio and retention pages for the partner for the review quarter.
Compare loss ratio against the threshold set for the partner tier and state the position.
Record any partner challenge to the figures as a queried item in the meeting note.
Done when loss ratio and retention have been reviewed with the partner present.
verify: Confirm the loss ratio figure for the review quarter appears in the pack presented.
Pass when loss ratio and retention pages for the review quarter are evidenced in the pack.

steps.title: Capture partner commitments verbatim in the CRM meeting note
sop: Record each partner commitment such as premium target or new business mix word for word.
Attribute each commitment to the individual who gave it during the meeting.
Avoid paraphrasing a numeric commitment into a range or approximation.
Done when every commitment made in the meeting is recorded verbatim on the CRM note.
verify: Read back the commitments on the CRM note against the meeting recording or notes.
Pass when each commitment carries a number or measurable target and a named committer.

steps.title: Agree growth plan actions and close the meeting with the Head of Distribution
sop: Summarise the growth plan positions agreed for the coming quarter.
Confirm with the partner which items become tracked actions before the meeting closes.
Confirm the date of the next QBR verbally with the partner principal.
Done when the growth actions and next meeting date are agreed in the meeting.
verify: Check the CRM note lists the agreed growth actions and the next QBR date.
Pass when the agreed actions and next meeting date are recorded before the activity is closed.

steps.title: Issue minutes for partner sign-off by email and file them in CRM
sop: Draft the minutes from the CRM meeting note within 3 business days of the meeting.
Email the minutes to the partner principal and internal attendees for confirmation.
Upload the signed-off minutes to the partner record within 5 business days of the meeting.
Done when signed-off minutes are attached to the CRM partner record.
verify: Compare the minutes upload date against the meeting date on the CRM activity.
Pass when signed-off minutes are attached within 5 business days of the meeting date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The pre-read pack for each partner with a QBR scheduled in the coming period.
generic.In-scope period: The review quarter covered by the pack, issued before the scheduled QBR date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pack version, send date, distribution list and partner reference are recorded on the partner record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Packs issued equal the number of scheduled QBRs for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The exact version sent is stored in SharePoint with its send timestamp, not a working draft.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any pack issued inside the 5 day window is logged with reason and relationship owner approval.
generic.Test population: All pre-read packs issued for QBRs scheduled in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any pack was sent fewer than 5 business days before its meeting date.
generic.Exception handling path: Late packs trigger a meeting deferral request or a documented waiver from the relationship owner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pack accepted when it holds production, loss ratio, service SLA and open action sections.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint partner document folder plus the CRM distribution record on the partner account.

steps.title: Assemble the pre-read pack sections in Microsoft 365 SharePoint
sop: Create the pack from the standard pre-read template in the partner SharePoint folder.
Populate the production, loss ratio, service SLA and open action-item sections.
Leave no section blank, state no data available with a reason where a figure is missing.
Done when all four standard sections are populated in the pack.
verify: Open the pack and check each of the four required sections has content.
Pass when production, loss ratio, service SLA and open action sections are all present.

steps.title: Pull open action items from CRM into the pack
sop: Filter the CRM action-item list for the partner where status is not closed.
Copy each open item with owner, due date and current status into the actions section.
Mark items overdue at the pack cut date so they surface in the meeting.
Done when every open CRM action item for the partner appears in the pack.
verify: Compare the pack action list count against the CRM open action count for the partner.
Pass when the two counts match at the stated pack cut date.

steps.title: Screen the pack for partner-confidential figures before external send
sop: Review every table and chart for data belonging to any other partner.
Replace cross-partner comparisons with anonymised peer-tier averages only.
Remove internal-only commentary such as underwriting appetite debate notes.
Done when the pack contains only this partner's figures plus anonymised benchmarks.
verify: Scan every page of the outgoing pack for a named third-party partner or producer code.
Pass when no other partner is identifiable anywhere in the pack.

steps.title: Obtain relationship owner confirmation of the pack before issue
sop: Review the assembled pack against the agenda agreed for the QBR.
Raise any figure or commentary that should not go to the partner in this form.
Confirm release by replying to the analyst in email or Teams.
Done when the relationship owner has confirmed the pack is fit to issue.
verify: Check the confirmation message is stored against the partner record.
Pass when a dated relationship owner confirmation exists before the send timestamp.

steps.title: Issue the pack by email at least 5 business days before the QBR
sop: Count back 5 business days from the booked QBR date to set the latest send date.
Send the pack to the partner principal and internal attendees from the shared mailbox.
Attach the exact SharePoint version, not a re-exported local copy.
Done when the pack has been sent on or before the latest send date.
verify: Compare the email send date against the QBR date recorded in CRM.
Pass when the send date is at least 5 business days before the meeting date.

steps.title: Record the distribution list on the CRM partner record
sop: Log every recipient name and organisation against the partner account in CRM.
Record the send date and the pack version reference on the same entry.
Note any recipient added at partner request so scope changes are visible.
Done when the full distribution list and send date are on the CRM partner record.
verify: Open the CRM distribution entry and compare recipients against the sent email.
Pass when every emailed recipient appears on the CRM distribution record.

steps.title: Lock the issued version in the SharePoint partner folder
sop: Move the issued pack into the partner folder final subfolder in SharePoint.
Set the file to read only so the issued version cannot be silently edited.
Keep any later revision as a new version rather than overwriting the issued file.
Done when the issued version is stored read only with its send date recorded.
verify: Open the stored file and confirm its version label and send date metadata.
Pass when the stored version matches the emailed attachment and carries the send date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All partner action items past their due date and still open in the CRM action log.
generic.In-scope period: The period from the last escalation run to the current review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Escalation date, channel, recipient and follow-up date are populated on each escalated item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Escalations raised equal the count of overdue open action items in the run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The escalation email or Teams message is linked to the action item with its send timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items not escalated carry a documented reason and relationship owner agreement.
generic.Test population: Every overdue open partner action item at the escalation run date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any overdue partner action item has no recorded escalation entry.
generic.Exception handling path: Items overdue beyond 30 days are escalated to the Head of Distribution as a second tier.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Escalation accepted when date, channel, recipient and follow-up date are all recorded.
generic.Evidence location: CRM action item escalation fields plus the linked case in the workflow case management tool.

steps.title: Filter the CRM action-item log for overdue open items
sop: Open the partner action-item view in CRM and filter status not closed.
Add a filter for due date earlier than today to isolate overdue items.
Export the resulting list as the escalation working set for this run.
Done when the overdue open action-item list is produced for the run.
verify: Re-run the filter and compare the row count against the exported working set.
Pass when the exported list count equals the CRM overdue open item count.

steps.title: Identify the named partner principal for each overdue item in CRM
sop: Look up the partner principal contact on each partner account in CRM.
Confirm the principal contact is current and not a departed individual.
Do not default the escalation to the day to day account contact.
Done when each overdue item has a named partner principal recipient.
verify: Check each working set row carries a named principal, not a generic contact.
Pass when every overdue item names an active partner principal as escalation recipient.

steps.title: Send the escalation to the partner principal by email or Teams
sop: Write the escalation stating the item, original due date and days overdue.
Send it to the partner principal with the internal relationship owner copied.
Request a revised completion date in the escalation message.
Done when the escalation has been sent to the named partner principal.
verify: Open the sent item and confirm the principal is the primary addressee.
Pass when the escalation was sent to the partner principal and not only the account contact.

steps.title: Record escalation date and channel on the CRM action item
sop: Set the escalation date field on the action item to the send date.
Set the escalation channel field to email or Teams as used.
Paste the escalation message reference or link into the item notes.
Done when escalation date and channel are recorded on every escalated item.
verify: Open a sample of escalated items and read the escalation date and channel fields.
Pass when no escalated item has a blank escalation date or channel.

steps.title: Raise items overdue beyond 30 days to the Head of Distribution
sop: Filter the escalation working set for items overdue by more than 30 days.
Compile these into a single notification with partner, item and days overdue.
Send the notification to the Head of Distribution by email.
Done when every item overdue beyond 30 days is notified to the Head of Distribution.
verify: Compare the notified list against the working set 30 day filter.
Pass when every item overdue beyond 30 days appears in the notification.

steps.title: Set a follow-up date on every escalated item in the case tool
sop: Open each escalated item in the workflow case management tool.
Set a follow-up date consistent with the revised date requested from the partner.
Do not close the escalation step while any item lacks a follow-up date.
Done when every escalated item carries a future follow-up date.
verify: Query escalated items for a null or past follow-up date.
Pass when no escalated item is left without a future follow-up date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every agency being terminated in the period plus all sub-producers under its agency code.
generic.In-scope period: From notice service through to the effective exit date and code deactivation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exit date, notice served date, transition route and commission settlement status are all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Sub-producer codes addressed in the exit plan equal those active under the parent agency code.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The signed termination notice with served date is filed against the parent agreement in the CLM repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unsettled commission or advance balances are logged with an agreed settlement schedule.
generic.Test population: All agency terminations with an effective exit date in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if agency status is not Terminated with an effective date matching the exit letter.
generic.Exception handling path: A shortened notice period requires Legal Counsel approval recorded against the agreement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exit accepted when notice, transition route, settlement and code deactivation are all evidenced.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle management repository agreement record plus the producer management system agency record.

steps.title: Read the notice period from the agency agreement in the CLM repository
sop: Open the executed agency agreement in the contract lifecycle management repository.
Read the termination clause notice period and required delivery method.
Confirm the planned exit date allows the notice period to run in full.
Done when the required notice period and exit date compatibility are confirmed.
verify: Compare the served notice date and exit date against the clause notice period.
Pass when the full notice period has been served before the exit date.

steps.title: Agree and document the book-of-business transition route in CRM
sop: Assess the in-force book by policy count, premium and renewal dates.
Select transfer to a receiving agency, run-off, or reassignment to direct servicing.
Record the chosen route and its rationale on the CRM partner record.
Done when the transition route is documented on the partner record.
verify: Open the CRM partner record and read the recorded transition route.
Pass when the route is one of transfer, run-off or reassignment with a stated rationale.

steps.title: List all sub-producers under the agency code in the producer system
sop: Query the agency producer management system for producers under the parent agency code.
Include producers whose appointments derive from the agency contract.
Add each sub-producer to the exit plan with its intended treatment.
Done when every sub-producer under the agency code appears in the exit plan.
verify: Compare the exit plan sub-producer list against the producer system query result.
Pass when both counts match with no sub-producer unaddressed.

steps.title: Settle or schedule commission and advance balances
sop: Obtain the outstanding commission and advance balance position for the agency code.
Agree either settlement before exit or a documented repayment schedule.
Record the settlement or schedule reference against the agency record.
Done when every outstanding balance is settled or scheduled with a reference.
verify: Check the agency balance position after the settlement entries are posted.
Pass when no unaddressed commission or advance balance remains for the agency.

steps.title: File the signed termination notice against the parent agreement
sop: Obtain the signed termination notice and the proof of delivery.
Upload both to the parent agreement record in the CLM repository.
Record the served date and effective exit date as structured fields.
Done when the signed notice and served date are filed against the agreement.
verify: Open the parent agreement record and read the attached notice and served date.
Pass when a signed termination notice with a served date is filed against the agreement.

steps.title: Deactivate the agency code in the producer management system
sop: Set the agency record status to Terminated on the effective exit date.
Confirm no new business can be submitted under the agency code after that date.
Retain the record rather than deleting it so history stays queryable.
Done when the agency code is deactivated with the effective exit date recorded.
verify: Read the agency status and effective date in the producer management system.
Pass when status is Terminated with an effective date matching the exit letter.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every commitment agreed during the QBR for the partner under review.
generic.In-scope period: The current QBR cycle, with due dates falling before the next scheduled review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Owner, due date, success criterion and linked meeting record are populated on each item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged action items equal the commitments recorded in the QBR minutes.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each action item links to the dated QBR meeting record on the partner account.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Commitments not converted to actions are noted with the reason in the minutes.
generic.Test population: All action items created from the current QBR for the partner.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any action item lacks a named owner, due date or success criterion.
generic.Exception handling path: Items without a willing named owner are returned to the relationship owner for assignment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Item accepted when it is atomic, owned, dated and measurable.
generic.Evidence location: CRM action-item records on the partner account plus the workflow case management tool queue.

steps.title: Extract the commitment list from the QBR minutes in CRM
sop: Open the QBR meeting record on the partner account in CRM.
List each commitment captured verbatim in the meeting note.
Separate any bundled commitment into its individual components.
Done when a one line per commitment list has been produced from the minutes.
verify: Compare the extracted list against the commitments in the minutes.
Pass when every minuted commitment appears exactly once in the extracted list.

steps.title: Create one CRM action item per commitment
sop: Create a separate CRM action item for each extracted commitment.
Title each item with the action verb and the specific subject.
Do not combine two commitments into a single item for convenience.
Done when the action item count equals the extracted commitment count.
verify: Count the created CRM action items for this QBR against the commitment list.
Pass when the counts match with no bundled entries.

steps.title: Assign a named individual owner to every item in CRM
sop: Set the owner field on each item to a named internal or partner individual.
Reject team names, mailbox names or department names as owners.
Confirm the named partner owner was present or is named in the minutes.
Done when every action item carries a named individual owner.
verify: Query the QBR action items for owners that are not individual contacts.
Pass when no action item carries a team-level or generic owner.

steps.title: Set due dates ahead of the next scheduled QBR
sop: Read the next scheduled QBR date from the CRM partner record.
Set each item due date so it falls before that next QBR date.
Where a commitment genuinely spans quarters, set an interim milestone date.
Done when every item has a due date earlier than the next QBR date.
verify: Compare each item due date against the next scheduled QBR date.
Pass when no item due date falls on or after the next QBR date.

steps.title: State a measurable success criterion on each item
sop: Write the success criterion as a number, percentage or dated deliverable.
Avoid criteria such as improve service that cannot be tested.
Use the metric named in the commitment where the partner gave one.
Done when every item carries a measurable success criterion.
verify: Read the success criterion on each item and test whether it can be measured.
Pass when every criterion states a number, percentage or dated deliverable.

steps.title: Link each action item to the QBR meeting record
sop: Set the related meeting field on each action item to the QBR activity.
Confirm each item also carries the partner account reference.
Mirror the item into the workflow case management queue where tracking requires it.
Done when every action item links back to the QBR record on the partner account.
verify: Open the QBR activity and list the linked action items.
Pass when every created item appears linked to the QBR meeting record.

steps.title: Review the logged item set with the relationship owner
sop: Read the logged items against the minutes for completeness and wording.
Correct any owner, date or criterion that misstates the commitment made.
Confirm acceptance of the logged set in CRM.
Done when the relationship owner has confirmed the logged action set.
verify: Check the relationship owner confirmation is recorded against the QBR activity.
Pass when a dated confirmation of the logged action set exists in CRM.

generic.Defined scope/population: All partners at or above the strategic premium threshold in the producer management system.
generic.In-scope period: The current register refresh cycle using the latest closed premium period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Relationship owner, tier, review cadence and status are populated on every register row.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Register row count reconciles to active agency codes above the strategic threshold.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The register version and refresh date are recorded with the reconciliation output.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rows failing reconciliation are logged with the correction made and by whom.
generic.Test population: Every active strategic partner row on the register at the refresh date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any active strategic partner row lacks a relationship owner or review cadence.
generic.Exception handling path: Rows with a departed owner are reassigned by the Agency Relations Manager before publication.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Register accepted when it reconciles to producer system codes and every row is fully populated.
generic.Evidence location: The strategic partner register in CRM plus the reconciliation extract on the BI reporting platform.

steps.title: Extract partners above the strategic threshold from the BI platform
sop: Run the written premium extract by agency code for the latest closed twelve months.
Apply the approved strategic premium threshold to the extract.
State the data cut date on the extract output.
Done when the list of partners meeting the strategic threshold is produced.
verify: Re-run the threshold filter on the same extract and compare counts.
Pass when the qualifying partner count is reproducible from the stated cut date.

steps.title: Add missing qualifying partners to the register in CRM
sop: Compare the qualifying list against the current register rows.
Create a register row for each qualifying partner not already present.
Populate agency code, legal name and qualifying premium on each new row.
Done when every partner above the threshold appears on the register.
verify: Match the qualifying list against register rows by agency code.
Pass when no qualifying partner is missing from the register.

steps.title: Validate that each row names a currently employed relationship owner
sop: Read the relationship owner on every register row.
Check each named owner is an active employee in the current org list.
Reassign rows whose owner has left or changed role.
Done when every register row names a currently employed relationship owner.
verify: Query register rows for owners not present in the active employee list.
Pass when no register row names a departed or vacant relationship owner.

steps.title: Align review cadence on each row to the assigned partner tier
sop: Read the assigned tier for each partner from the producer management system.
Set the register cadence field to the cadence the tier policy requires.
Correct any row where cadence and tier disagree.
Done when every row cadence matches its assigned tier.
verify: Compare cadence against tier across all register rows.
Pass when no row shows a cadence inconsistent with its tier.

steps.title: Mark exited partners rather than leaving stale active rows
sop: Identify register rows whose agency code is terminated in the producer system.
Set those rows to Exited with the termination effective date.
Retain the row so historical review evidence stays queryable.
Done when no terminated agency remains marked active on the register.
verify: Cross check register active rows against producer system terminated codes.
Pass when no terminated agency code is shown as active on the register.

steps.title: Reconcile the register count to active agency codes
sop: Count active register rows and active qualifying agency codes in the producer system.
List any difference by agency code with the reason for the difference.
Correct the register or raise a producer data defect as appropriate.
Done when the register count reconciles to active qualifying agency codes.
verify: Read the reconciliation output for unexplained differences.
Pass when every difference between the two counts carries a documented explanation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every partner flagged at risk or non-performing on the current partner scorecard.
generic.In-scope period: From the scorecard period that raised the flag through to plan closure.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger, milestone dates, review checkpoint and partner acknowledgement are recorded on each plan.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open remediation plans equal the count of partners flagged at risk on the scorecard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Partner acknowledgement is filed on the account with its date and plan version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Flagged partners without a plan are logged with reason and Producer Compliance Manager decision.
generic.Test population: All partners carrying an at-risk flag in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any at-risk partner lacks a plan with trigger, milestones and review date.
generic.Exception handling path: Partners refusing to acknowledge a plan are escalated for tier downgrade or exit assessment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Plan closed only after two consecutive periods of sustained improvement.
generic.Evidence location: CRM partner account plan record plus the GRC platform remediation entry.

steps.title: List at-risk flagged partners from the scorecard in CRM
sop: Open the current partner scorecard output and filter for at-risk status.
Match each flagged partner to its CRM partner account.
Check whether an open remediation plan already exists for each.
Done when the at-risk partner list with plan status is produced.
verify: Compare the flagged list against open plans in CRM.
Pass when every flagged partner is shown as either having or needing a plan.

steps.title: Open a remediation plan in the GRC platform for each unplanned partner
sop: Create a remediation plan record in the GRC platform for each flagged partner without one.
Link the plan to the CRM partner account and the scorecard period.
Assign the relationship owner as plan owner.
Done when every at-risk partner has an open remediation plan.
verify: Query GRC for at-risk partners without an open plan.
Pass when no at-risk partner is left without an open remediation plan.

steps.title: State the trigger explicitly on each plan
sop: Record whether the trigger is loss ratio, volume shortfall or a conduct finding.
Quote the measured value and the threshold it breached.
Attach the scorecard or finding reference that evidences the trigger.
Done when each plan states its trigger with the measured value.
verify: Read the trigger field on each open plan.
Pass when every plan names one of the three trigger types with a measured value.

steps.title: Set milestone dates and the review checkpoint on each plan
sop: Break the required improvement into dated milestones in the GRC plan.
Set a review checkpoint date at which progress will be formally assessed.
Assign a named owner to each milestone.
Done when every plan carries milestone dates and a review checkpoint.
verify: Query plans for missing milestone dates or a null review checkpoint.
Pass when no open plan lacks milestones or a review checkpoint date.

steps.title: Record partner acknowledgement of the plan on the CRM account
sop: Send the plan to the partner principal and request written acknowledgement.
Upload the acknowledgement to the CRM partner record with its date.
Escalate to the Producer Compliance Manager where acknowledgement is refused.
Done when partner acknowledgement or a refusal escalation is on the account.
verify: Open the CRM partner record and read the acknowledgement entry.
Pass when a dated acknowledgement or a logged refusal escalation exists for each plan.

steps.title: Track improvement and close only after two sustained periods
sop: At each period close, compare the triggering metric against the plan target.
Record the period result on the GRC plan record.
Close the plan only once two consecutive periods meet the target.
Done when the plan is closed on two sustained periods or remains open with the result recorded.
verify: Read the period results recorded against each closed plan.
Pass when no plan is closed with fewer than two consecutive improved periods evidenced.

generic.Defined scope/population: Each strategic partner requiring an annual business plan for the coming plan year.
generic.In-scope period: The plan year, aligned to the agency agreement term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Written premium, new business, retention commitments and marketing spend are stated as numbers.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Agreed partner premium commitments roll up to the channel plan total for the year.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The signed plan is filed in the CLM repository with its version and signature dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Plans agreed outside appetite or unsigned at year start are logged with a Head of Distribution decision.
generic.Test population: All strategic partners with an annual plan due for the plan year.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any plan on file lacks numeric production and growth commitments.
generic.Exception handling path: Class or territory mix outside appetite is referred to underwriting before agreement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Plan accepted when signed by both the partner principal and the Head of Distribution.
generic.Evidence location: Contract lifecycle management repository plan record linked to the CRM partner account.

steps.title: Build the draft plan targets from BI platform trend data
sop: Pull the partner written premium, new business and retention trend from the BI platform.
Set draft written premium, new business and retention targets for the plan year.
State each target as an absolute number rather than a percentage uplift alone.
Done when numeric draft targets exist for premium, new business and retention.
verify: Read the draft plan for each of the three commitment types.
Pass when premium, new business and retention are each stated as numbers.

steps.title: Test the target class and territory mix against underwriting appetite
sop: List the classes and territories the plan expects the partner to write.
Compare each against the current underwriting appetite statement.
Refer any class or territory outside appetite before it is agreed.
Done when every planned class and territory sits inside current appetite or is referred.
verify: Check each planned class and territory against the appetite statement.
Pass when no planned class or territory is outside appetite without a recorded referral.

steps.title: Cost and approve any joint marketing spend commitment
sop: Cost each proposed joint marketing activity in the plan.
Confirm the total sits within the approved distribution marketing budget.
Record the approval of the spend commitment before agreement with the partner.
Done when marketing spend is costed and approved or removed from the plan.
verify: Read the marketing section of the plan for costed figures and an approval reference.
Pass when every marketing commitment is costed and carries an approval reference.

steps.title: Align the plan year to the agency agreement term in the CLM repository
sop: Read the agency agreement effective and expiry dates from the CLM repository.
Set the plan year start and end to align with the agreement term.
Flag any misalignment to be resolved before the plan is signed.
Done when the plan year dates align to the agreement term.
verify: Compare plan year dates against the agreement term dates.
Pass when the plan year falls inside the agreement term.

steps.title: Negotiate the final commitments with the partner principal
sop: Present the draft plan to the partner principal and work through each commitment.
Record every agreed change to a target with the reason.
Do not accept a commitment that removes the numeric basis of a target.
Done when all commitments are agreed with the partner principal.
verify: Compare the negotiated plan against the draft for any target reduced to non-numeric wording.
Pass when every negotiated commitment remains stated as a number.

steps.title: Obtain dual sign-off and file the plan in the CLM repository
sop: Sign the agreed plan and obtain the partner principal signature.
File the signed plan against the agency agreement in the CLM repository.
Link the plan record to the CRM partner account for review reporting.
Done when the signed plan is filed and linked to the partner account.
verify: Open the filed plan and read the two signature blocks and dates.
Pass when a signed plan with both signatures and numeric commitments is on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: The QBR agenda for each partner with a review scheduled in the current quarter.
generic.In-scope period: The full review quarter, with data extracts cut at a single stated date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Agenda sections, data cut date, carried-forward actions and compliance items are all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Carried-forward action count equals open prior-QBR actions in CRM for the partner.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The confirmed agenda version is stored in the SharePoint partner folder with its date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Agenda sections omitted at the relationship owner's request are logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All agendas prepared for QBRs scheduled in the quarter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the agenda pack does not state the data extract cut date or omits the review quarter.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing data extracts are chased with the BI team before the agenda is circulated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Agenda accepted once confirmed by the relationship owner before issue.
generic.Evidence location: Microsoft 365 SharePoint partner folder plus the CRM meeting record.

steps.title: Open the standard QBR agenda template in SharePoint
sop: Copy the current approved QBR agenda template from the SharePoint template library.
Confirm the template holds production, loss, service, growth and actions sections.
Save the working copy into the partner folder for the review quarter.
Done when a working agenda based on the current template exists in the partner folder.
verify: Compare the working agenda section list against the template section list.
Pass when all five standard sections are present in the working agenda.

steps.title: Attach production and loss ratio extracts from the BI platform
sop: Run the partner production and loss ratio reports for the review quarter.
Record the data cut date used for both extracts on the agenda front page.
Attach the extracts to the agenda pack in the partner folder.
Done when both extracts are attached with a single stated cut date.
verify: Read the cut date on the agenda and on each attached extract.
Pass when both extracts share the stated cut date and cover the full review quarter.

steps.title: Carry forward open prior-QBR actions from CRM
sop: Filter CRM action items for the partner where the source is the prior QBR and status is open.
Copy each into the agenda actions section with owner, due date and status.
Mark items overdue at the agenda cut date.
Done when every open prior-QBR action appears in the agenda.
verify: Compare the agenda carried-forward count against the CRM open prior-QBR count.
Pass when the counts match at the agenda cut date.

steps.title: Add compliance and conduct items raised for the partner
sop: Request any open compliance or conduct item for the partner from producer compliance.
Add each item to the agenda with its status and the compliance owner.
Record a nil return where compliance confirms there are no items.
Done when compliance items or a nil return are recorded on the agenda.
verify: Read the compliance section of the agenda.
Pass when it lists open compliance items or an explicit nil return.

steps.title: Circulate the draft agenda to the relationship owner in CRM
sop: Send the draft agenda to the relationship owner for confirmation.
Log the circulation against the QBR meeting record in CRM.
Hold issue to the partner until confirmation is returned.
Done when the draft agenda has been circulated for confirmation.
verify: Check the CRM meeting record for the circulation entry.
Pass when a dated circulation entry precedes any issue to the partner.

steps.title: Confirm the agenda content as relationship owner
sop: Review the agenda against the partner position and prior meeting outcomes.
Add or remove discussion items so the agenda reflects the current relationship.
Confirm the final agenda in writing to the analyst.
Done when the relationship owner has confirmed the final agenda.
verify: Locate the written confirmation against the CRM meeting record.
Pass when a dated relationship owner confirmation exists before the agenda is issued.

generic.Defined scope/population: All escalated partner service and relationship issues open in the case management tool.
generic.In-scope period: From case creation to case closure within the review period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Partner reference, resolution note, root cause code and partner acceptance are populated on each case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed case count reconciles to cases with a resolution note and root cause code.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The resolution communication date and partner acceptance are recorded on the case.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases closed without partner acceptance are logged with the reason and manager approval.
generic.Test population: Every escalated partner issue case closed in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any closed case lacks a resolution note or a root cause code.
generic.Exception handling path: Remedies beyond the resolver's authority are referred to the Distribution Operations Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case closed when resolution, root cause and partner acceptance are all recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management tool case record linked to the CRM partner account.

steps.title: Log the escalated issue as a case with a partner reference
sop: Create a case in the workflow case management tool before any resolution work begins.
Set the partner reference and link the case to the CRM partner account.
Record the issue as reported by the partner in the case description.
Done when the case exists with a partner reference before work starts.
verify: Compare the case creation timestamp against the first work note timestamp.
Pass when the case was created before any resolution activity was recorded.

steps.title: Investigate the issue against CRM and system records
sop: Pull the CRM interaction history and any related service records for the partner.
Establish the sequence of events and where the service failure occurred.
Record the findings as a case work note.
Done when the investigation findings are recorded on the case.
verify: Read the case work notes for a findings entry.
Pass when the case carries a dated investigation findings note.

steps.title: Confirm resolver authority for the proposed remedy
sop: Identify the remedy proposed such as fee waiver, backdate or underwriting exception.
Check the remedy against the delegated authority thresholds for the resolver.
Approve or refer the remedy upward where it exceeds the resolver authority.
Done when the remedy sits inside a recorded authority or has been referred.
verify: Read the authority check note against the remedy on the case.
Pass when the remedy applied is within the recorded authority of its approver.

steps.title: Communicate the agreed resolution to the partner
sop: Set out the resolution and any remedy in writing to the partner contact.
Record the communication date on the case.
Attach the communication to the case record.
Done when the resolution has been communicated and the date recorded.
verify: Open the case and read the resolution communication date and attachment.
Pass when a dated resolution communication is attached to the case.

steps.title: Capture the root cause code before closure
sop: Select the root cause from the controlled root cause code list on the case.
Avoid selecting other where a specific code applies.
Add a short note explaining the code selection.
Done when a root cause code and explanatory note are set on the case.
verify: Query closed cases for a blank or other root cause code.
Pass when no closed case lacks a specific root cause code.

steps.title: Record partner acceptance and close the case
sop: Request confirmation from the partner that the resolution is accepted.
Record the acceptance and its date on the case.
Close the case only once acceptance or an approved exception is recorded.
Done when the case is closed with partner acceptance recorded.
verify: Read the acceptance field on each closed case.
Pass when every closed case shows partner acceptance or an approved exception.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner requiring a QBR booking under its tier cadence.
generic.In-scope period: The quarter in which the cadence requires the review to be held.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Scheduled date, invitee list and partner principal are recorded on the CRM partner record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Booked QBR count equals the count of partners whose cadence requires a review this quarter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The calendar invitation and the CRM scheduled date entry carry the booking timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deferrals are re-logged with a new date rather than cancelled, with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All Tier 1 and Tier 2 partners at the scheduling run date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any Tier 1 or Tier 2 partner has no future QBR date recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Partners declining a booking are escalated to the relationship owner for cadence resolution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Booking accepted when the date allows a 15 business day pre-read window.
generic.Evidence location: CRM partner record scheduled date field plus the Teams calendar invitation.

steps.title: List partners due a QBR this quarter from CRM
sop: Filter CRM partner accounts by tier and last QBR date.
Identify partners whose cadence requires a review inside the current quarter.
Exclude partners already holding a future booked QBR date.
Done when the list of partners needing a booking is produced.
verify: Re-run the cadence filter and compare against the produced list.
Pass when every partner due a review this quarter appears on the list.

steps.title: Propose dates inside the cadence window
sop: Select candidate dates that fall inside the quarter the cadence requires.
Set the earliest candidate at least 15 business days ahead of today.
Check the relationship owner availability before proposing to the partner.
Done when candidate dates inside the cadence window are ready to propose.
verify: Check each candidate date against the cadence quarter and the 15 day rule.
Pass when every candidate sits inside the cadence quarter and 15 business days ahead.

steps.title: Invite the partner principal and relationship owner by Teams calendar
sop: Create the Teams meeting invitation for the agreed date.
Invite the partner principal named on the CRM partner record.
Invite the internal relationship owner and any required analyst support.
Done when the invitation has been sent to the principal and relationship owner.
verify: Open the sent invitation and read the invitee list.
Pass when both the partner principal and relationship owner are invited.

steps.title: Record the scheduled date on the CRM partner record
sop: Set the next QBR date field on the CRM partner account to the booked date.
Record the booking date so cadence compliance can be reported.
Link the meeting activity to the partner account.
Done when the scheduled date is recorded on the CRM partner record.
verify: Read the next QBR date field on the partner account.
Pass when the recorded date matches the accepted calendar invitation.

steps.title: Re-log rather than cancel where the partner defers
sop: Agree a replacement date with the partner when a deferral is requested.
Update the CRM scheduled date rather than deleting the activity.
Record the deferral reason against the meeting activity.
Done when every deferral results in a replacement date and a recorded reason.
verify: Query deferred QBR activities for a missing replacement date.
Pass when no deferred QBR is left without a replacement date and reason.

steps.title: Confirm cadence coverage as relationship owner
sop: Review the booked QBR dates across the Tier 1 and Tier 2 portfolio.
Chase any partner still without a future date.
Escalate persistent non-engagement to the Head of Distribution.
Done when every Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner holds a future QBR date or an escalation.
verify: Query Tier 1 and Tier 2 partners for a null future QBR date.
Pass when a future QBR date is recorded for every Tier 1 and Tier 2 partner.

generic.Defined scope/population: All active agency and broker records in the producer management system at the run date.
generic.In-scope period: A full rolling twelve months of written premium and loss ratio.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Tier, tier date, override reason and approver are populated where applicable on each agency record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tiered agency count equals active agency records in the producer management system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The tiering run output is retained with its data cut date and threshold version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every manual override is logged with reason and named approver.
generic.Test population: All active agency records included in the tiering run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any active agency record has a blank tier after the run.
generic.Exception handling path: Material tier shifts against the prior run are investigated before write-back.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Run accepted when thresholds were applied unchanged and overrides are documented.
generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform tiering run output plus the agency tier field in the producer system.

steps.title: Extract twelve months of premium and loss from the data warehouse
sop: Query the enterprise data warehouse for written premium by agency code over a rolling twelve months.
Query the matching incurred loss and earned premium for the same window.
State the data cut date on the extract.
Done when a twelve month premium and loss extract by agency code exists.
verify: Check the extract period start and end against the rolling twelve month rule.
Pass when the extract covers a full rolling twelve months with a stated cut date.

steps.title: Apply the approved tier thresholds in the BI platform
sop: Load the approved tier threshold set into the BI tiering model.
Run the model across the extract without manual adjustment.
Record the threshold version used with the run output.
Done when the tiering run has produced a tier for every agency in the extract.
verify: Compare the thresholds in the model against the approved threshold set.
Pass when the run used the approved thresholds with no undocumented adjustment.

steps.title: Document every manual tier override with reason and approver
sop: List agencies where the proposed tier differs from the model result.
Record the business reason for each override on the run output.
Record the named approver for each override.
Done when every override carries a reason and a named approver.
verify: Query the override list for blank reason or approver fields.
Pass when every manual tier override carries a documented reason and approver.

steps.title: Write the resulting tier back to the producer management system
sop: Load the final tier and tier date to the agency record in the producer system.
Confirm the load covered every agency in the run output.
Investigate and correct any agency rejected by the load.
Done when every agency in the run has its tier written back.
verify: Query active agency records for a blank tier field.
Pass when no active agency record has a blank tier after the run.

steps.title: Compare the new tier distribution against the prior run
sop: Build a movement matrix of prior tier against new tier in the BI platform.
Identify agencies moving two or more tiers in either direction.
Write an explanation for each material shift.
Done when every material tier shift carries a written explanation.
verify: Read the movement matrix and the explanations recorded.
Pass when each two-tier or greater movement has a documented explanation.

steps.title: Publish the tiering run output and archive the version
sop: Publish the tiering output with cut date, threshold version and override list.
Archive the published version so the run can be reproduced.
Notify relationship owners of tier changes affecting their partners.
Done when the run output is published and archived with its version.
verify: Open the archived output and confirm cut date and threshold version are present.
Pass when the archived run states cut date, threshold version and overrides.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open partner action items between the last QBR and the next scheduled review.
generic.In-scope period: The interval since the previous status refresh, at minimum monthly.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Status, completion date and evidence reference are populated on each updated item.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open, closed and overdue counts sum to the total action items for the partner.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each completion carries a dated evidence reference on the action item.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items closed on assurance alone are reopened and logged as an exception.
generic.Test population: All action items updated in the refresh cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any completed action item lacks a completion date or evidence reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Items due before the next refresh are flagged to the relationship owner immediately.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An item is complete only when named evidence supports the claimed completion.
generic.Evidence location: CRM action item status fields plus the workflow case management tool tracker.

steps.title: Run the monthly action-item status refresh in CRM
sop: Open the partner action-item list in CRM at the agreed refresh interval.
Contact each action owner for a current status on their open items.
Record the refresh date against the partner account.
Done when every open item has been reviewed in the refresh cycle.
verify: Compare the last refresh date against the agreed interval.
Pass when the refresh occurred within the agreed interval, at minimum monthly.

steps.title: Name the supporting evidence on each status update
sop: For each item claimed complete, record the evidence document or system reference.
Attach the evidence to the action item where the file is available.
Reject a status update that names no evidence.
Done when every completion claim names its supporting evidence.
verify: Query completed items for a blank evidence reference.
Pass when each completed action item carries a completion date and evidence reference.

steps.title: Flag items falling due before the next refresh
sop: Filter open items whose due date falls before the next scheduled refresh.
Notify each owner that the item will fall due inside the interval.
Mark the items so they surface in the next status run.
Done when every item due before the next refresh has been flagged.
verify: Re-run the due-date filter against the flagged set.
Pass when every item due before the next refresh carries the flag.

steps.title: Report the open closed and overdue split to the relationship owner
sop: Count items by status open, closed and overdue for the partner.
Send the split to the relationship owner with the refresh date.
Log the report against the CRM partner account.
Done when the status split has been reported to the relationship owner.
verify: Check the reported counts sum to the total action items for the partner.
Pass when the three status counts reconcile to the total item count.

steps.title: Reject closures resting on partner verbal assurance
sop: Review items set to complete since the last refresh.
Reopen any item whose completion rests on verbal assurance alone.
Record the reopening reason on the item.
Done when no item remains closed on verbal assurance alone.
verify: Sample closed items and read the evidence recorded.
Pass when no closed item cites only a verbal assurance as evidence.

steps.title: Sync the refreshed status into the case management tracker
sop: Update the mirrored items in the workflow case management tool.
Confirm status and due dates match the CRM action items.
Correct any divergence at the CRM source, not in the tracker only.
Done when the tracker reflects the refreshed CRM status for every item.
verify: Compare a sample of items across CRM and the case tracker.
Pass when status and due date agree across both systems for every sampled item.

generic.Defined scope/population: All active partners requiring a health score refresh for the current review period.
generic.In-scope period: The current review period, using production, loss, service and compliance inputs at one cut date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Health score, score date, QBR outcome and governance status are populated on each partner record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scored partner count equals active partners in the producer management system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The score date and component input versions are recorded with each score.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Partners with a missing component input are excluded and logged rather than scored.
generic.Test population: All active partner records at the score run date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any active agency record is left without a governance status value.
generic.Exception handling path: Scores crossing the watch threshold trigger the at-risk workflow automatically.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Score accepted when every component input has a value and the score date is in period.
generic.Evidence location: CRM partner record score fields plus the BI reporting platform score run output.

steps.title: Assemble score component inputs in the BI platform
sop: Pull production, loss, service and compliance component values for the period.
Confirm all four component sources share the same data cut date.
State the cut date on the score run output.
Done when all four components are assembled at a single cut date.
verify: Compare the cut date across all four component extracts.
Pass when all components share the stated cut date.

steps.title: Exclude partners with a missing component rather than scoring them
sop: List partners where any component input has no value.
Exclude those partners from the score run and log the missing component.
Raise a data request to fill the missing component before the next run.
Done when no partner is scored with a missing component input.
verify: Query the score run for scores computed from an incomplete component set.
Pass when no score exists where a component input was missing.

steps.title: Recompute the health score and write it to the CRM partner record
sop: Run the health score model over the assembled components.
Write the refreshed score and the score date to the CRM partner record.
Confirm the write covered every partner in the run.
Done when the refreshed score and score date are on every scored partner record.
verify: Read the score date on active partner records.
Pass when the health score date falls within the current review period for every active partner.

steps.title: Record the QBR outcome on the partner record
sop: Read the QBR minutes and summarise the review outcome for the period.
Record the outcome on the CRM partner record alongside the score.
Link the outcome entry to the QBR meeting activity.
Done when the QBR outcome is recorded on the partner record.
verify: Open the partner record and read the QBR outcome entry.
Pass when the outcome entry links to the QBR activity for the period.

steps.title: Set the governance status on the agency record
sop: Derive Good Standing, Watch or At Risk from the refreshed score bands.
Write the governance status to the agency record in the producer system.
Correct any active agency record left without a status.
Done when every active agency record carries a governance status.
verify: Query active agency records for a blank governance status.
Pass when no active agency record is left without a governance status value.

steps.title: Trigger the at-risk workflow where the watch threshold is crossed
sop: Identify partners whose score crossed the watch or at-risk threshold this period.
Confirm the automated at-risk workflow fired for each of them.
Raise the workflow manually where automation did not fire and log the defect.
Done when every threshold crossing has an at-risk workflow raised.
verify: Compare threshold crossings against raised at-risk workflows.
Pass when every partner crossing the threshold has an at-risk workflow raised.

generic.Defined scope/population: Each coverholder with an in-force binding authority requiring an oversight file.
generic.In-scope period: The current oversight cycle covering the last four bordereaux submission periods.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Agreement, authority schedule, audit report, findings status and bordereaux references are all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Bordereaux included equal the last four expected submissions for the coverholder.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each document is filed with its version and date in the compliance evidence repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing documents are logged with the owner chasing them and a target date.
generic.Test population: All coverholders with an in-force binder at the compile date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the file lacks agreement, authority schedule, latest audit report or bordereaux.
generic.Exception handling path: Documents unavailable at compile are flagged to the oversight forum with a retrieval date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: File accepted when indexed so any single document can be produced on request.
generic.Evidence location: Compliance evidence repository oversight file indexed by coverholder reference.

steps.title: Assemble the binder agreement and authority schedule in the evidence repository
sop: Retrieve the executed binding authority agreement from the document management repository.
Retrieve the current authority schedule and every amendment in force.
File all three together under the coverholder oversight file.
Done when the agreement, schedule and amendments sit in one oversight file.
verify: Open the oversight file and list the agreement and schedule documents.
Pass when the agreement, authority schedule and all amendments are present.

steps.title: Add the latest audit report and findings log from the GRC platform
sop: Export the latest coverholder audit report from the GRC platform.
Export the findings log with open and closed status and corrective action state.
File both in the oversight file with their export date.
Done when the audit report and findings log are in the oversight file.
verify: Read the findings log in the oversight file for open and closed entries.
Pass when open and closed audit findings for the coverholder are both listed.

steps.title: Add the last four bordereaux and their validation exception reports
sop: Identify the last four expected bordereaux submission periods for the binder.
Retrieve each submission and its validation exception report.
Log any missing period as an exception with a chase owner.
Done when four submissions and their exception reports are filed or logged as missing.
verify: Count bordereaux in the file against the four expected periods.
Pass when four submissions are present or each gap carries a logged exception.

steps.title: Add MGA licensing and regulatory registration evidence
sop: Retrieve the coverholder licensing and appointment evidence from the document repository.
Retrieve any regulatory registration or approval held by the MGA.
Confirm each document is current and not expired at the compile date.
Done when current licensing and registration evidence is filed.
verify: Check expiry dates on each licensing and registration document filed.
Pass when no filed licensing or registration document is expired at the compile date.

steps.title: Index the oversight file for single-document retrieval
sop: Build an index listing each document, its type, period and repository location.
Confirm each index entry resolves to a retrievable document.
Store the index at the head of the oversight file.
Done when every document in the file is indexed and retrievable.
verify: Pick three index entries at random and retrieve the documents.
Pass when every sampled index entry produces its document on request.

steps.title: Confirm file completeness against the oversight checklist
sop: Compare the file contents against the standard oversight file checklist.
Record any gap with the owner and target date for closure.
Sign the file as complete or complete with logged gaps.
Done when the file is signed against the oversight checklist.
verify: Read the signed checklist and any logged gaps.
Pass when the file contains agreement, schedule, audit report and bordereaux or logged gaps.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every binding authority expiring within the assessment horizon of 90 days.
generic.In-scope period: The expiring binder period, using the latest closed loss ratio and premium data.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Financial standing, licensing, E&O currency, loss ratio and recommendation are all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assessments completed equal binders expiring in the next 90 days.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The dated assessment and its supporting evidence are filed in the GRC platform.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Binders assessed after expiry are logged with reason and Head of Distribution decision.
generic.Test population: All binders with an expiry date inside the next 90 days.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any binder expiring within 90 days lacks a dated renewal assessment.
generic.Exception handling path: Expired E&O or lapsed licensing suspends the renewal until evidence is refreshed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment accepted when completed before binder expiry with a recorded recommendation.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform renewal assessment record linked to the CLM binder agreement.

steps.title: List binders expiring within 90 days from the CLM repository
sop: Run the binder expiry report in the contract lifecycle management repository.
Filter for binders expiring inside the next 90 days.
Create a GRC assessment record for each binder on the list.
Done when every binder expiring within 90 days has an assessment record.
verify: Compare the expiry report against open GRC assessment records.
Pass when a dated renewal assessment exists for every binder expiring in the next 90 days.

steps.title: Re-test MGA financial standing licensing and E&O currency
sop: Obtain current financial statements or a credit assessment for the MGA.
Verify licensing status in the producer management system for each state written.
Confirm the E&O certificate is current beyond the proposed new binder period.
Done when financial standing, licensing and E&O currency are all tested and recorded.
verify: Read the E&O expiry date recorded against each active MGA.
Pass when no active MGA has an expired E&O certificate on file.

steps.title: Compare loss ratio and premium volume against the binder limits
sop: Pull actual loss ratio and written premium for the binder period.
Compare each against the loss ratio threshold and aggregate limit in the binder.
Record the utilisation percentage and any breach on the assessment.
Done when actual performance is recorded against the binder limits.
verify: Read the loss ratio and aggregate utilisation on the assessment record.
Pass when both are recorded against the limits stated in the binder.

steps.title: Confirm prior-year audit findings are closed or remediated
sop: List prior-year audit findings for the coverholder in the GRC platform.
Confirm each is closed with evidence or carries an accepted remediation plan.
Record any finding neither closed nor planned as a renewal blocker.
Done when every prior-year finding is closed, planned or flagged as a blocker.
verify: Query prior-year findings for the coverholder by status.
Pass when no finding is open without an accepted remediation plan.

steps.title: Record the renewal recommendation with proposed authority changes
sop: State the recommendation for the new period on the GRC assessment.
State any authority limit, class or territory change proposed.
Attach the supporting evidence for the recommendation.
Done when the recommendation and proposed authority changes are recorded.
verify: Read the recommendation field on the completed assessment.
Pass when the assessment states a recommendation and any authority limit changes.

steps.title: Complete the assessment before the binder expiry date
sop: Review the completed assessment against the binder expiry date.
Sign the assessment as complete before expiry.
Escalate any assessment at risk of missing the expiry date.
Done when the assessment is signed before the current binder expiry.
verify: Compare the assessment completion date against the binder expiry date.
Pass when the assessment was completed before the current binder expiry date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The selected sample of policies and claims bound under the binder in the audit period.
generic.In-scope period: The audit period stated in the audit scope for the coverholder.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pass or fail, test attribute, policy or claim reference and exception note are recorded per test.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tested item count equals the selected sample size for the audit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Working papers and evidence extracts are filed in the compliance evidence repository with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each exception is logged with its policy or claim reference and a proposed finding.
generic.Test population: Every policy and claim in the approved audit sample.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any sampled item lacks a recorded result against every test attribute.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-authority risks without prior consent are raised as high-severity findings.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Audit complete when all attributes are tested across the full sample with results recorded.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform audit working papers plus the compliance evidence repository.

steps.title: Load the approved sample into the GRC audit working paper
sop: Import the approved policy and claim sample into the GRC audit record.
Confirm the imported count matches the approved sample size.
Set up a test attribute row for each item.
Done when the full sample is loaded with test attribute rows ready.
verify: Compare the loaded item count against the approved sample size.
Pass when the loaded sample count equals the approved sample size.

steps.title: Test each sampled risk against class limit and territory in the policy system
sop: Open each sampled policy in the policy administration system.
Compare class, limit per risk and territory against the binder authority.
Record pass or fail with the policy reference for each attribute.
Done when class, limit and territory are tested for every sampled risk.
verify: Query the working paper for sampled risks missing a class limit or territory result.
Pass when every sampled risk carries a result for all three attributes.

steps.title: Test referral cases for prior written consent before bind
sop: Identify sampled risks that required referral under the binder.
Locate the prior written consent and compare its date against the bind date.
Record a fail where consent is missing or post-dates the bind.
Done when every referral case has a consent test result recorded.
verify: Compare consent dates against bind dates for every referral case tested.
Pass when every out-of-authority sampled risk shows prior written consent before bind.

steps.title: Test sampled claims for reserve adequacy and settlement authority
sop: Open each sampled claim in the policy administration system.
Assess reserve adequacy against the claim facts at the review date.
Compare settlement amounts against the claims authority in the binder.
Done when reserve and settlement authority results are recorded for every sampled claim.
verify: Query the working paper for sampled claims missing a reserve or authority result.

generic.Defined scope/population: Policies and claims bound under the binder within the audit period.

steps.title: Define the sample population from the policy administration system

Record the resulting population size on the sample sheet.

steps.title: Set the sample size from the approved sampling standard

Apply the sampling standard sample size for that tier and population.
Record the sample size and standard reference on the sample sheet.
Done when the sample size is set from the approved standard.
verify: Compare the sample size against the standard for the tier and population.
Pass when the sample size matches the approved sampling standard.

steps.title: Apply risk-based selection for large limits referrals and severe claims
sop: Select all risks above the large limit threshold in the population.
Select all referral cases and high-severity claims in the population.
Record the risk-based selection criteria on the sample sheet.
Done when the risk-based portion of the sample is selected and recorded.
verify: Compare selected risk-based items against the stated criteria.

steps.title: Add a random element and record the seed
sop: Select the remaining sample randomly from the residual population.

verify: Re-run the random selection with the recorded seed.

steps.title: Confirm coverage of every product line written under the binder

Top up the sample where a product line is unrepresented.

verify: Compare product lines in the sample against product lines in the population.
Pass when the sample sheet shows coverage of every product line written.

steps.title: Approve the sample sheet before fieldwork

File the approved sample sheet against the GRC audit record.
Done when the approved sample sheet is filed before fieldwork starts.
verify: Read the filed sample sheet for all five required elements.
Pass when the sheet records population, sample size, selection method and product line coverage.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open corrective actions arising from MGA audit findings across coverholders.

steps.title: Track each corrective action against its due date in the GRC platform

Request a status update from each MGA action owner.
Record the status and any revised expectation against each action.

sop: Compare the evidence submitted against the closure evidence requirement.

Attach accepted evidence to the action in the evidence repository.

Pass when no action is closed without its pre-agreed closure evidence attached.

steps.title: Re-test a sample of remediated items rather than accepting assertion
sop: Select a sample of items covered by the remediated control.

Record the re-test result against the finding.
Done when a re-test result is recorded for each remediated finding.
verify: Read the re-test result recorded against closed findings.
Pass when no finding is closed without a re-test or reviewer sign-off.

steps.title: Escalate actions overdue beyond the grace period
sop: Filter actions past due date plus the agreed grace period.
Escalate each to the delegated authority oversight forum.
Record the escalation and the forum instruction on the action.
Done when every action beyond the grace period has been escalated.
verify: Query actions overdue beyond grace for an escalation entry.
Pass when every overdue action beyond the grace period carries an escalation.

steps.title: Report the finding position per MGA at each oversight meeting
sop: Compile open, overdue and closed finding counts per MGA.

Submit the position to the oversight forum ahead of the meeting.
Done when the finding position per MGA has been reported to the forum.
verify: Check the reported counts sum to total findings raised per MGA.

steps.title: Close findings only on evidence plus reviewer sign-off

Pass when no finding is closed without attached closure evidence and a re-test or sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every ingested bordereau file awaiting validation for the period.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any file progressed downstream with an unresolved mandatory-field or duplicate exception.
generic.Exception handling path: Failed files are returned to the coverholder for correction and resubmission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: File accepted when template, mandatory fields and duplicate checks all pass.
generic.Evidence location: Data catalog quality tool validation run plus the staging tables in the data warehouse.

steps.title: Validate the file against the agreed column template
sop: Load the agreed column template and data types for that coverholder.
Run the schema validation against the ingested file in the data quality tool.
Record every column mismatch and data type failure.
Done when the schema validation has run and results are recorded.
verify: Read the schema validation result for the file.
Pass when column set and data types match the agreed template for that coverholder.

steps.title: Check mandatory fields are fully populated
sop: Test policy reference, inception, limit, premium, class and territory for nulls.
