Fail the file where any mandatory field holds a null.
Done when mandatory field completeness has been tested and recorded.
verify: Read the null counts per mandatory field on the validation run.
Pass when every mandatory field shows a zero null count on accepted files.

steps.title: Check for duplicate policy references within and across periods
sop: Test for duplicate policy references within the submitted file.
Test each reference against prior accepted submissions for the coverholder.
Record every duplicate found with both occurrences.
Done when duplicate testing within and across periods is complete.
verify: Read the duplicate test result for the file.
Pass when no duplicate policy reference remains unresolved on accepted files.

steps.title: Raise a data exception report back to the coverholder
sop: Compile the schema, mandatory field and duplicate failures into an exception report.
Send the report to the coverholder with a resubmission deadline.
Log the exception against the coverholder record in the producer system.
Done when every failed file has an exception report issued.

Pass when every failed file has an exception report issued to the coverholder.

Pass when no bordereau progressed downstream while holding an unresolved exception.

sop: Write the validation pass or fail result to the ingestion log entry.

Done when every ingested file has a recorded validation outcome.
verify: Query the ingestion log for files without a validation outcome.
Pass when every ingested file for the period carries a validation result.

generic.Defined scope/population: All risks bound by the MGA under each in-force binder in the tested period.

sop: Read the structured authority fields from the binder register row.

sop: For each out-of-authority risk, locate the prior referral approval.

Mark risks with no prior approval as breaches.

sop: Create a GRC breach record for each unapproved out-of-authority risk.

Assign a named owner and route the record to the oversight queue.

verify: Compare unapproved out-of-authority risks against raised breach records.
Pass when every such risk carries a raised breach record with an owner.

sop: Review the reconciliation, exclusions and unmapped code lists.

Done when the aggregation is approved for scorecard calculation.

sop: Open the scorecard review record for the territory in CRM.

Separate bundled steps into individual actions.

sop: Create a separate action in the workflow case management tool per step.

sop: Read the next scorecard period end date.
Set each action due date on or before that date.

sop: Set the producer code field on each action from the CRM producer record.
Set the scorecard period that triggered the action.
Confirm the link resolves to a live producer record.
Done when every action carries a producer code and scorecard period link.
verify: Query actions for a missing producer code or scorecard period.
Pass when no corrective action exists without a linked producer code and period.

steps.title: Obtain owner acknowledgement in the tracker
sop: Notify each named owner of their assigned actions.
Require acknowledgement in the tracker rather than by email only.
Chase unacknowledged actions before the review cycle closes.

Compute the variance against each comparison basis.

Approve the KPI run for scorecard assembly.
Done when the KPI run is approved for scorecard assembly.

steps.title: Check prohibited comparisons and guarantees by state

Check comparisons and guarantee wording against each state prohibition.
Record any prohibited wording as a required change.

Pass when no approved piece contains wording prohibited in a target state.

steps.title: Record the disposition with reviewer and date

State the required changes where approved with changes.
Done when the disposition, reviewer and date are recorded.

Pass when every reviewed piece carries a disposition, reviewer and date.

steps.title: Assign an approval reference and expiry date
sop: Assign an approval reference to each approved piece.
Set an expiry date so the piece cannot be used indefinitely.
Publish the reference and expiry to the marketing automation platform.
Done when every approved piece carries a reference and expiry date.
verify: Query approved pieces for a missing reference or expiry date.
Pass when no marketing piece is in use without an approval reference and expiry.

steps.title: Retain the approved version with its substantiation file

File the substantiation evidence alongside the approved version.
Link both to the GRC review register entry.
Done when the approved version and substantiation are filed together.

Pass when the approved version and its substantiation file are retained together.

generic.Defined scope/population: All findings from internal audit, self-testing and external examination affecting distribution.

generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The register export and ageing report are retained with their run dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Findings without an accountable owner are escalated before the oversight meeting.
generic.Test population: All open findings on the register.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any open finding lacks a source, severity, owner or due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed severities escalate to the compliance oversight meeting for decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Register accepted when all three sources feed one consolidated register.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform findings register plus the compliance evidence repository.

steps.title: Consolidate findings from all three sources into one register
sop: Collect findings from internal audit, self-testing and external examination.
Log each into the single GRC distribution findings register.
Avoid maintaining a separate register per source.
Done when all three sources feed the single register.
verify: Compare source system finding counts against register entries.
Pass when every finding from all three sources appears once on the register.

steps.title: Record source raise date severity and closure evidence per entry
sop: Record the source and raise date on each register entry.
Record the severity from the approved severity scale.
State the closure evidence required at the point of raise.
Done when every entry records source, raise date, severity and closure evidence.
verify: Query register entries for any of the four fields blank.
Pass when no open finding lacks a source, severity or closure evidence requirement.

steps.title: Assign a single accountable owner to each finding
sop: Assign one named accountable owner per finding.
Reject shared or team ownership.
Notify each owner of their assigned findings.
Done when every finding carries a single named owner.
verify: Query register entries for a blank or team-level owner.
Pass when no open finding lacks a single named accountable owner.

steps.title: Set due dates from the severity-based remediation timeframe
sop: Read the remediation timeframe for the assigned severity.
Set the due date from the raise date plus that timeframe.
Record any agreed deviation with the approver.
Done when every finding has a severity-consistent due date.
verify: Compare due dates against severity remediation timeframes.
Pass when every due date matches its severity timeframe or carries an approved deviation.

steps.title: Report ageing of open findings at each oversight meeting
sop: Produce the ageing report of open findings by severity and owner.
Highlight findings overdue against their due date.
Submit the ageing to the compliance oversight meeting.
Done when the ageing report has been submitted for the meeting.
verify: Compare the ageing report against the open register entries.
Pass when the ageing report covers every open register finding.

steps.title: Reconcile the register to the source records each cycle
sop: Compare register entries against audit, self-test and exam source records.
Add any finding missing from the register.
Record the reconciliation date and result.
Done when the register reconciles to all three source record sets.
verify: Read the reconciliation result for unexplained differences.
Pass when the register reconciles to the three source record sets.

generic.Defined scope/population: All distribution policies and procedures identified by the regulatory impact assessment.
generic.In-scope period: From assessment to publication ahead of the regulatory effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Version, regulatory driver, approver, effective date and change history are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents updated equal documents identified by the impact assessment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The published version and its change history are retained in the document repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents not updated in time are logged with a target date and interim control.
generic.Test population: All policies and procedures identified as impacted.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any superseded distribution policy version remains published as current.
generic.Exception handling path: Documents needing more time carry an interim instruction issued to the field.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Publication accepted when downstream artefacts reference the new version.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository policy record plus the GRC policy register.

steps.title: Update the sections identified by the impact assessment
sop: Read the impact assessment for the specific sections requiring change.
Draft the revised wording for each identified section.
Avoid rewriting sections the assessment did not identify.
Done when every identified section has revised wording drafted.
verify: Compare the drafted changes against the impact assessment section list.
Pass when every identified section has been revised.

steps.title: Version the document and record driver and effective date
sop: Increment the document version in the document management repository.
Record the regulatory driver and effective date in the change history.
Summarise the change made in the history entry.
Done when the version, driver and effective date are recorded.
verify: Read the change history entry on the new version.
Pass when the published version carries the regulatory driver and effective date.

steps.title: Route the revision through the defined approval authority
sop: Identify the approval authority defined in the policy standard.
Route the revision to that authority for approval.
Record the approver and the approval date on the document.
Done when the revision is approved by the defined authority.
verify: Read the approver against the policy standard authority.
Pass when the approver holds the authority defined in the policy standard.

steps.title: Publish the approved version and withdraw the superseded one
sop: Publish the approved version as current in the document repository.
Withdraw the superseded version from circulation.
Remove superseded copies from SharePoint working locations.
Done when only the approved version is published as current.
verify: Search the repository and SharePoint for superseded versions marked current.
Pass when no superseded distribution policy version remains published as current.

steps.title: Update downstream checklists portal content and training
sop: List downstream artefacts referencing the policy.
Update each to reference the new version.
Confirm training and portal content reflect the change.
Done when every downstream artefact references the new version.
verify: Sample downstream artefacts for the referenced policy version.
Pass when every sampled artefact references the new version.

steps.title: Record the update against the regulatory change in the GRC platform
sop: Link the published policy version to the regulatory change record.
Close the implementation action for the policy update.
Attach the published version as closure evidence.
Done when the policy update closes its implementation action with evidence.
verify: Read the closed implementation action and its attached evidence.
Pass when the closure evidence is the published policy version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every producer requesting writing authority in one or more states.
generic.In-scope period: The verification performed before writing authority is enabled.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Appointment status, licence class, screening result, verification date and NIPR reference are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: States verified equal states in which the producer will write.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The NIPR reference and verification date are retained on the producer record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States without an active appointment are logged and authority withheld for those states.
generic.Test population: All producers granted writing authority in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any producer holds enabled writing authority in a state without an active appointment.
generic.Exception handling path: Open conduct restrictions block authority until the restriction is resolved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Verification accepted when the NIPR reference is recorded before authority is granted.
generic.Evidence location: NIPR verification record plus the producer management system authority fields.

steps.title: Confirm an active appointment exists in every writing state via NIPR
sop: List the states in which the producer will write.
Query NIPR for an active carrier appointment in each state.
Record the appointment status per state on the producer record.
Done when appointment status is confirmed for every writing state.
verify: Compare enabled writing states against confirmed active appointments.
Pass when no producer holds writing authority in a state without an active appointment.

steps.title: Confirm the licence class covers the lines to be written
sop: Read the licence class held in each state from NIPR.
Compare against the lines the producer will write.
Withhold authority for any line the licence class does not cover.
Done when licence class coverage is confirmed for every line.
verify: Compare enabled lines against licence class coverage per state.
Pass when every enabled line is covered by the licence class held.

steps.title: Confirm sanctions and background screening results are clear
sop: Run or retrieve the sanctions and background screening result.
Confirm the result is clear and within its currency window.
Escalate any adverse result before authority is granted.
Done when a clear and current screening result is recorded.
verify: Read the screening result and its date on the producer record.
Pass when a clear screening result within its currency window is recorded.

steps.title: Confirm no open conduct restriction or pending termination
sop: Check the producer record for open conduct restrictions.
Check for a pending termination in progress.
Withhold authority where either exists.
Done when the producer is confirmed free of restrictions and pending termination.
verify: Query producers with enabled authority for open restrictions.
Pass when no producer with an open restriction holds enabled writing authority.

steps.title: Record the verification date and NIPR reference before enabling authority
sop: Record the appointment verification date on the producer record.
Record the NIPR reference supporting the verification.
Do not enable authority before both are recorded.
Done when verification date and NIPR reference are recorded.
verify: Compare the verification record date against the authority enablement date.
Pass when the verification date and NIPR reference are recorded before authority is granted.

steps.title: Enable writing authority in the policy administration system
sop: Enable writing authority for the verified states and lines only.
Confirm the authority configuration matches the verification result.
Record the enablement date and the enabler.
Done when authority is enabled only for verified states and lines.
verify: Compare enabled authority configuration against the verification record.
Pass when enabled states and lines match exactly the verified states and lines.

generic.Defined scope/population: All producer records in terminated status past any applicable hold period.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records under legal or exam hold are logged and excluded from archiving for destruction.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any record under legal or exam hold has been archived for destruction.
generic.Exception handling path: Records with an unclear hold status are held back pending legal confirmation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archive accepted when records remain retrievable by producer code and state.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository archive index plus the producer management system record.

steps.title: Confirm terminated status and hold period elapsed
sop: List producer records in terminated status in the producer management system.
Confirm any applicable hold period has elapsed for each.
Exclude records still inside a hold period.
Done when only eligible terminated records remain in the archive set.
verify: Compare the archive set against terminated status and hold period rules.
Pass when no record inside a hold period is present in the archive set.

steps.title: Assemble agreement licensing commission and conduct history together
sop: Collect the agreement, licensing, appointment, commission and conduct history.

Avoid archiving one record type without the others.
Done when a complete archive set exists per producer.
verify: Open a sample archive set and check for all five record types.
Pass when every archive set contains all five record types.

steps.title: Apply the retention clock from the termination effective date
sop: Read the termination effective date from the producer record.
Compute the retention expiry from that date, not the archive date.
Record the retention expiry on the archive entry.
Done when retention expiry is computed from the termination effective date.
verify: Recompute retention expiry from the termination effective date for a sample.
Pass when every archive entry carries a retention expiry date from the termination date.

steps.title: Confirm no litigation or examination hold applies
sop: Check each producer against the litigation and examination hold list.
Exclude any held record from destruction scheduling.
Record the hold check date on the archive entry.
Done when hold status is checked and recorded for every archived record.
verify: Cross check archived records against the current hold list.
Pass when no record under legal or exam hold has been archived for destruction.

steps.title: Index the archive by producer code and state
sop: Set producer code and state as index keys on each archive entry.
Confirm retrieval by each key returns the archive set.
Store the index in the document management repository.
Done when every archive entry is indexed by producer code and state.
verify: Retrieve two archive sets by producer code and by state.
Pass when archived producer records are retrievable by producer code with a retention expiry date.

steps.title: Update the producer record to reflect the archive
sop: Record the archive date and archive reference on the producer record.
Confirm the producer record itself is retained, not deleted.
Confirm the archive reference resolves from the producer record.
Done when every archived producer record links to its archive reference.
verify: Open a sample producer record and follow the archive reference.
Pass when the archive reference resolves to the archived record set.

steps.title: List every mandatory producer attribute

Mark each as mandatory or optional.

sop: Define the uniqueness key such as NPN plus entity type.

Record the surviving-record rule for merges.

Pass when each mandatory attribute states its role in the uniqueness key.

steps.title: State the authoritative source system per attribute

Confirm the named system actually owns the attribute.
Log attributes with disputed ownership for governance decision.
Done when every attribute names an authoritative source system.
verify: Query the standard for attributes without a named source system.
Pass when each mandatory attribute names a source system.

steps.title: Implement the validation rules in the data quality tool
sop: Configure each validation rule in the data catalog quality tool.
Test each rule against known good and bad values.
Version the rule set to match the standard version.
Done when the tooling rules match the published standard.
verify: Compare a sample of tool rules against the standard definitions.
Pass when validation rules in the tooling match the published master data standard.

steps.title: Obtain data governance forum approval and publish
sop: Table the standard at the data governance forum.
Record the approval decision and date.
Publish the versioned standard to SharePoint before it takes effect.
Done when the approved standard is published before its effective date.
verify: Compare the approval date against the standard effective date.
Pass when governance approval predates the standard taking effect.

generic.Defined scope/population: All producer data domains covering identity, licensing, hierarchy and banking.
generic.In-scope period: The current stewardship review cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Steward name, domain, system role and exception queue assignment are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Domains with a named steward equal the defined producer data domains.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The stewardship assignment list is retained with its review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vacant stewardship roles are logged and escalated to the data governance forum.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any producer data domain is without a named current steward.
generic.Exception handling path: Departing stewards are reassigned before their departure date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Stewardship accepted when each steward holds the system role their domain requires.
generic.Evidence location: Data catalog quality tool stewardship register plus the IAM platform role assignments.

steps.title: Name a data steward for each producer data domain
sop: List the producer data domains covering identity, licensing, hierarchy and banking.
Assign a named steward to each domain in the data catalog tool.
Reject team-level stewardship.
Done when every domain has a named individual steward.

Pass when no producer data domain is without a named current steward.

steps.title: Confirm each steward holds the required system role in IAM
sop: Read the system role each domain requires to action its data.

Request the role where it is missing.

Pass when every steward holds the system role needed for their domain.

steps.title: Route data quality exceptions to the domain steward automatically
sop: Configure exception routing by domain in the data quality tool.

Remove any manual routing step that bypasses the rule.
Done when exceptions route automatically to the domain steward.

steps.title: Review steward assignments on role holder change

Reassign the domain before the departure date.
Record the reassignment on the stewardship register.
Done when no domain is left with a departing steward.
verify: Compare steward names against the active employee list.
Pass when no exception queue is assigned to a departed or vacant steward.

steps.title: Monitor steward queues for unactioned exceptions
sop: Report the age of items in each steward exception queue.
Chase stewards with items beyond the action window.
Escalate persistent inaction to the Distribution Operations Manager.
Done when queue ageing is reported and chased.
verify: Read the queue ageing report against the action window.
Pass when every queue item beyond the action window has a chase record.

steps.title: Report unactioned queues to the data governance forum
sop: Compile unactioned queue counts by steward and domain.
Report the position to the data governance forum.
Record the forum instruction against each domain.
Done when unactioned queues are reported to the forum.
verify: Compare the reported queue position against the tool queue counts.
Pass when the reported counts equal the tool queue counts at the cut date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All users and roles with any access to producer master data.

generic.Exception handling path: Role change or exit triggers same-day access removal.

generic.Evidence location: IAM platform entitlement records plus the GRC recertification evidence.

steps.title: Map producer data access to defined roles in the IAM platform
sop: List current producer data entitlements in the IAM platform.
Map each entitlement to a defined role rather than an individual grant.
Remove individual grants once the role equivalent exists.
Done when producer data access is granted only through defined roles.
verify: Query producer data entitlements for individual grants.
Pass when no producer data access remains as an individual grant.

steps.title: Restrict banking tax ID and commission rate fields
sop: Identify the roles that genuinely require banking, tax ID and rate access.

Remove the fields from all other roles.
Done when sensitive fields are visible only to the roles requiring them.

steps.title: Limit write access to authorised stewards
sop: List users holding write access to producer master fields.
Compare against the approved steward role holders.
Remove write access from anyone outside the steward roles.

verify: Compare producer master write access holders against steward roles.

steps.title: Run the access recertification at the required interval

Require each manager to confirm or revoke each entitlement.
Chase incomplete reviews before the campaign closes.
Done when the recertification campaign is complete for the cycle.
verify: Read the campaign completion status in the IAM platform.
Pass when a completed recertification of producer data access exists for the current cycle.

steps.title: Remove access at role change or exit on the effective day
sop: Monitor leaver and role change events affecting producer data access.
Remove or amend access on the day the change takes effect.
Record the removal date against the user.
Done when access changes are actioned on the effective day.
verify: Compare access removal dates against role change effective dates.
Pass when no access removal lags the effective date of the change.

steps.title: Record the access position in the GRC platform
sop: Export the post-recertification access position by role.
File it as control evidence in the GRC platform.
Raise findings for any exception left open.
Done when the access position is filed as GRC control evidence.
verify: Open the GRC control evidence and read the access position.
Pass when the filed position matches the IAM entitlement state at cycle close.

generic.Defined scope/population: All producer attributes shared across distribution and policy administration systems.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attributes in the hierarchy document equal mandatory attributes in the master data standard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The hierarchy document version and review date are retained.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Divergent downstream values are logged with a correction owner and date.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any producer attribute shows a downstream value diverging from its authoritative source.
generic.Exception handling path: Requests to change the authoritative source route through data governance approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Hierarchy accepted when it names the authoritative system for every mandatory attribute.
generic.Evidence location: Data catalog quality tool lineage plus the hierarchy document in the repository.

steps.title: Record the authoritative system per producer attribute
sop: List mandatory producer attributes from the master data standard.
Record the authoritative system for each in the hierarchy document.
Cover both distribution and policy administration attributes.
Done when every mandatory attribute names its authoritative system.
verify: Compare the hierarchy document against the mandatory attribute list.
Pass when the hierarchy names the authoritative system for every mandatory attribute.

steps.title: Confirm downstream systems consume rather than locally edit
sop: Trace the integration path for each attribute into consuming systems.
Confirm the consuming system reads the authoritative value.
Flag any consuming system holding a local editable copy.
Done when local edit points are identified for every attribute.
verify: Test whether a consuming system permits a local edit of a shared attribute.
Pass when no consuming system permits a local edit of an authoritative attribute.

steps.title: Detect and report divergent downstream values
sop: Compare downstream attribute values against the authoritative source.
Report every divergence with the systems and values involved.
Assign a correction owner to each divergence.
Done when every divergence is reported with a correction owner.
verify: Query the divergence report for entries without a correction owner.
Pass when no producer attribute shows an uncorrected downstream divergence.

steps.title: Route authoritative source changes through data governance
sop: Log any request to change which system is authoritative.
Route the request to the data governance forum for decision.
Update the hierarchy only after the decision is recorded.
Done when authoritative source changes carry a governance decision.
verify: Compare hierarchy changes against governance decision records.
Pass when every authoritative source change carries a recorded governance decision.

steps.title: Update the hierarchy when integrations change
sop: Monitor integration changes affecting producer attribute flows.
Update the hierarchy document for each change.
Version the document with the change date.
Done when the hierarchy reflects the current integration landscape.
verify: Compare the hierarchy document against current integration configurations.
Pass when the document matches the current integration configuration.

steps.title: Publish the hierarchy to the data catalog
sop: Publish the reviewed hierarchy into the data catalog quality tool.
Link each attribute to its authoritative system in the catalog.
Notify data stewards of the published version.
Done when the hierarchy is published in the data catalog.
verify: Open the catalog and read the authoritative system per attribute.
Pass when the catalog reflects the published hierarchy for every attribute.

generic.Defined scope/population: All producer data change requests received in the period.

steps.title: Confirm the requester is authorised for that producer or agency
sop: Check the requester against the authorised contact list for the producer.

Done when requester authority is confirmed or the request rejected.

steps.title: Confirm supporting evidence is attached for the change type
sop: Identify the evidence required for identity, licensing, banking or hierarchy changes.

verify: Query applied changes for a missing evidence attachment.

steps.title: Apply dual control to banking and commission rate changes

Done when every banking or rate change carries two approvers.

Pass when no banking or commission-rate change was applied without a second approver.

sop: Identify the authoritative system for the attribute from the hierarchy.
Apply the change in that system only.
Let downstream systems synchronise rather than editing them directly.
Done when the change is applied only in the authoritative system.
verify: Compare the change application system against the hierarchy authoritative system.

steps.title: Record requester approver before and after values on the change log
sop: Write the requester, approver, before value and after value to the change log.
Link the log entry to the workflow request.
Confirm no log entry has a blank before or after value.
Done when the change log entry is complete for every change.
verify: Query the change log for blank requester, approver or value fields.

steps.title: Confirm downstream synchronisation after the change
sop: Check the changed attribute in the consuming systems after the sync window.
Raise a defect where a consuming system did not update.
Record the sync confirmation on the change request.

generic.Defined scope/population: All producer records across the producer master and connected source systems.

generic.Defined scope/population: All executed agreement amendments and commission term changes to be applied.
