steps.title: Select the reason from the controlled reason code list
sop: Open the termination record in the producer management system.
Select the reason from the controlled reason code list.
Reject free-text reason entry.
Done when a controlled reason code is selected.
verify: Query terminated producers for a blank or free-text reason.
Pass when no terminated producer record carries a blank or free-text reason.

steps.title: Record whether the termination is for cause
sop: Set the for-cause flag where the reason is conduct or compliance based.
Record the conduct finding reference where for cause applies.
Leave the flag unset only where the reason is genuinely not for cause.
Done when the for-cause position and any finding reference are recorded.
verify: Query for-cause terminations for a linked finding reference.
Pass when every for-cause termination links to a conduct or compliance finding.

steps.title: Attach the supporting evidence to the termination record
sop: Retrieve the investigation outcome, licence lapse report or inactivity report.
Attach the evidence to the termination record in the document repository.
Confirm the evidence supports the selected reason code.
Done when supporting evidence is attached to the termination record.
verify: Open the termination record and read the attached evidence.
Pass when every termination reason carries supporting evidence.

steps.title: Confirm the reason matches the state filing reason
sop: Read the reason code required by each state for the termination filing.
Confirm the internal reason maps to the state filing reason.
Correct any divergence before the filing is prepared.
Done when the internal reason maps to the state filing reason.
verify: Compare the internal reason against the state filing reason.
Pass when the recorded reason matches the reason to be filed with the state.

steps.title: Route potentially reportable reasons for legal review
sop: Identify reasons that could trigger a reportable event obligation.
Route the termination to Legal Counsel before the filing.
Record the legal review conclusion on the GRC record.
Done when every potentially reportable reason carries a legal review.
verify: Query potentially reportable terminations for a legal review entry.
Pass when every such termination carries a recorded legal review.

steps.title: Publish the reason to the GRC conduct register
sop: Write the reason code and for-cause position to the GRC conduct register.
Link the register entry to the producer record.
Confirm the entry is visible for compliance reporting.
Done when the reason is published to the GRC conduct register.
verify: Open the GRC register and read the termination entry.
Pass when the register entry matches the producer record reason and for-cause flag.

generic.Defined scope/population: All active producers evaluated against the termination eligibility rules.
generic.In-scope period: The inactivity threshold period plus the current licensing and conduct position.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger reason, in-force policy count and transfer plan reference are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Candidates listed equal producers meeting at least one eligibility trigger.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The candidate list is retained with its run date and rule version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Producers excluded for servicing needs are logged with the exclusion reason.
generic.Test population: All active producers evaluated in the run.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any producer with in-force policies is listed without a transfer plan reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Producers with in-force business route to the transfer planning task before listing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Candidate accepted when it carries a trigger reason and in-force policy count.
generic.Evidence location: BI reporting platform candidate list plus the producer management system status fields.

steps.title: Run the inactivity rule against the producer population
sop: Identify producers with no new business and no in-force policies beyond the threshold.
Record the last new business date and last in-force date per producer.
Add qualifying producers to the candidate list with the inactivity trigger.
Done when the inactivity rule has run across the producer population.
verify: Re-run the inactivity rule and compare candidate counts.
Pass when the inactivity candidates reproduce from the rule.

steps.title: Include producers with lapsed licences or terminated appointments
sop: Pull the NIPR licence and appointment position for active producers.
Identify producers with lapsed licences or appointments terminated elsewhere.
Add them to the candidate list with the licensing trigger.
Done when licensing-triggered candidates are on the list.
verify: Compare the licensing candidates against the NIPR position.
Pass when every lapsed-licence producer appears on the candidate list.

steps.title: Include producers with substantiated conduct findings
sop: List producers with substantiated conduct findings or unresolved restrictions.
Add them to the candidate list with the conduct trigger.
Reference the finding on each candidate row.
Done when conduct-triggered candidates are on the list with references.
verify: Compare conduct candidates against substantiated findings.
Pass when every substantiated conduct case producer appears on the list.

steps.title: Exclude producers with in-force business until a transfer plan exists
sop: Count in-force policies for each candidate.
Exclude candidates with in-force business and no transfer plan.
Record the exclusion reason and route to transfer planning.
Done when no candidate with in-force business lacks a transfer plan.
verify: Query candidates with in-force policies for a transfer plan reference.
Pass when no producer with in-force policies is listed without a transfer plan reference.

steps.title: Record trigger reason and in-force count per candidate
sop: Write the trigger reason and in-force policy count on each candidate row.
Where several triggers apply, list all of them.
State the run date on the candidate list.
Done when every candidate carries a trigger reason and in-force count.
verify: Query candidate rows for a blank trigger reason or in-force count.
Pass when each candidate carries a trigger reason and in-force policy count.

steps.title: Produce the candidate list for leadership review
sop: Compile the candidate list with triggers, counts and exclusions.
Submit to distribution leadership for review.
Record the review outcome per candidate.
Done when the candidate list has been submitted and reviewed.
verify: Read the review outcome recorded per candidate.
Pass when every candidate carries a leadership review outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full in-force book of business held by the terminating producer.
generic.In-scope period: From termination approval to the servicing transfer effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy count, premium, renewal dates, chosen route and receiving producer are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policies covered by the plan equal the producer in-force policy count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The transfer plan and its approval date are recorded on the producer record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies with no receiving producer are logged for direct servicing.
generic.Test population: All in-force policies attached to the terminating producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any in-force policy remains assigned after the transfer effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: States where the receiving producer is unlicensed route to direct servicing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Plan accepted when the ownership-of-expirations terms permit the chosen route.
generic.Evidence location: Policy administration system book extract plus the CRM transfer plan record.

steps.title: Quantify the in-force book by policy count premium and renewal dates
sop: Extract in-force policies for the producer from the policy administration system.
Summarise by policy count, premium and renewal date profile.
Record the extract cut date.
Done when the in-force book is quantified with a cut date.
verify: Re-run the extract and compare the policy count.
Pass when the quantified book reproduces from the policy system extract.

steps.title: Decide and document the transfer or wind-down route
sop: Choose transfer to a named receiving producer or wind-down to direct servicing.
Document the choice and its rationale on the CRM record.
Obtain relationship owner input before deciding.
Done when the route is documented with a rationale.
verify: Read the documented route on the CRM record.
Pass when the route is stated as transfer or wind-down with a rationale.

steps.title: Confirm the receiving producer is appointed and licensed by state
sop: List the states in the transferring book.
Confirm the receiving producer holds active appointment and licence in each.
Route states without coverage to direct servicing.
Done when receiving producer coverage is confirmed state by state.
verify: Compare the transferring book states against receiving producer appointments.
Pass when the receiving producer holds an active appointment in every state of the book.

steps.title: Confirm ownership-of-expirations terms permit the route
sop: Read the ownership of expirations clause in the producer agreement.
Confirm the chosen route is permitted under that clause.
Escalate to Legal Counsel where the clause is ambiguous.
Done when the route is confirmed permissible under the agreement.
verify: Compare the chosen route against the expirations clause.
Pass when the chosen route is permitted by the ownership-of-expirations terms.

steps.title: Set the servicing transfer effective date
sop: Set the transfer effective date so no policy is left unserviced.
Align it with the termination effective date where possible.
Record the date on the transfer plan.
Done when the servicing transfer effective date is set and recorded.
verify: Compare the transfer date against the termination effective date.
Pass when no gap exists between termination and servicing transfer.

steps.title: Execute the assignment in the policy administration system
sop: Reassign the in-force policies per the transfer plan on the effective date.
Confirm the assignment covered every policy in the book.
Record the assignment completion on the plan.
Done when every in-force policy is reassigned per the plan.
verify: Query the policy system for policies still assigned to the terminated producer.
Pass when no in-force policy remains assigned after the transfer effective date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every producer termination requiring a formal notice under the agreement.
generic.In-scope period: From notice preparation to the termination effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Notice period, delivery method, effective date, reason category and commission treatment are stated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notices issued equal approved terminations in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The issued notice and proof of delivery are retained with the issue date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Shortened notice periods are logged with legal approval.
generic.Test population: All termination notices issued in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the effective date on the record differs from the date stated in the notice.
generic.Exception handling path: State-specific notice requirements override the contractual minimum where stricter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notice accepted when sent by a method producing proof of delivery.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository notice file plus the CLM agreement record.

steps.title: Confirm the notice period and delivery method in the agreement
sop: Read the termination clause in the CLM agreement record.
Confirm the required notice period and delivery method.
Flag any proposed shortened notice for approval.
Done when the required notice period and method are confirmed.
verify: Compare the planned notice against the agreement clause.
Pass when the planned notice meets the agreement notice period and method.

steps.title: Confirm state notice requirements are met
sop: List the states in which the producer is appointed.
Check the state notice requirements for producer termination.
Apply the stricter of the contractual and state requirements.
Done when state notice requirements are confirmed for every state.
verify: Compare the notice against each state requirement.
Pass when the notice meets the requirement of every affected state.

steps.title: State effective date reason category and commission treatment
sop: Draft the notice stating the termination effective date.
State the reason category and the commission treatment after termination.
Avoid stating a reason beyond what the agreement and state require.
Done when the notice states all three elements.
verify: Read the notice for effective date, reason category and commission treatment.
Pass when the notice states all three elements.

steps.title: Send by a method producing proof of delivery
sop: Send the notice by the agreed method producing proof of delivery.
Use DocuSign or tracked delivery as the agreement requires.
Retain the proof of delivery.
Done when the notice is sent with proof of delivery retained.
verify: Open the notice file and check the proof of delivery.
Pass when the issued notice and its proof of delivery are retained with the issue date.

steps.title: Record the notice issue date and effective date on the producer record
sop: Write the notice issue date to the producer record.
Write the termination effective date as stated in the notice.
Confirm both values match the issued document.
Done when issue and effective dates are recorded on the producer record.
verify: Compare the recorded effective date against the notice.
Pass when the effective date on the record matches the date stated in the notice.

steps.title: File the notice against the agreement in the repository
sop: File the issued notice and proof of delivery against the parent agreement.
Set the agreement status to terminating with the effective date.
Notify downstream owners of the effective date.
Done when the notice is filed and the agreement status updated.
verify: Open the agreement record and retrieve the filed notice.
Pass when the notice and delivery proof are filed against the agreement.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force policyholders serviced by the terminated producer.
generic.In-scope period: The notification window around the termination effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy reference, notification date, new servicing contact and mailing proof are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notifications sent equal affected in-force policies at the effective date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Proof of mailing and the template version are retained with the send date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable notifications are logged with a re-send or alternative contact action.
generic.Test population: All affected in-force policyholders.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any affected in-force policyholder has no recorded producer change notification.
generic.Exception handling path: State timing rules override the standard window where stricter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notification accepted when it names the new servicing producer or contact.
generic.Evidence location: Policy administration system notification log plus the document repository mailing evidence.

steps.title: Identify every in-force policyholder serviced by the producer
sop: Extract in-force policies serviced by the terminated producer.
Resolve each to its policyholder mailing address.
Record the affected policyholder count.
Done when the affected policyholder population is identified.
verify: Re-run the extract and compare the policyholder count.
Pass when the affected population reproduces from the policy system.

steps.title: Confirm wording and timing meet each affected state requirement
sop: List the states in the affected book.
Check the notification wording and timing rules for each state.
Adjust the template and timing to meet the strictest requirement.
Done when wording and timing meet every affected state requirement.
verify: Compare the template and send timing against each state rule.
Pass when the notification meets the requirement of every affected state.

steps.title: State the new servicing producer or contact
sop: Read the receiving producer or direct servicing contact from the transfer plan.
State the new servicing contact clearly in the notification.
Include the contact route for policyholder questions.
Done when every notification names the new servicing contact.
verify: Read a sample notification for the servicing contact.
Pass when every notification names the new servicing producer or contact.

steps.title: Send within the required window of the effective date
sop: Schedule the mailing to fall inside the required window.
Execute the mailing run for the affected population.
Record the send date per policy.
Done when notifications are sent inside the required window.
verify: Compare send dates against the required window from the effective date.
Pass when every notification was sent within the required window.

steps.title: Retain proof of mailing and log against each policy record
sop: Retain the mailing evidence in the document repository.
Log the notification against each policy record in the policy system.
Record the template version used.
Done when mailing proof is retained and logged per policy.
verify: Query affected policies for a notification log entry.
Pass when no affected in-force policyholder is left without a recorded notification.

steps.title: Action undeliverable notifications
sop: List notifications returned undeliverable.
Locate an alternative address from CRM or the policy record.
Re-send and record the second attempt.
Done when every undeliverable notification has a re-send or logged exception.
verify: Query undeliverable notifications for a re-send record.
Pass when every undeliverable notification carries a re-send or logged exception.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every producer termination requiring distribution leadership approval.
generic.In-scope period: From approval request to the approval decision, before notice issue.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Trigger reason, in-force exposure, commission position and approval decision are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approvals recorded equal terminations proceeding to notice in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The approval decision, approver and date are recorded before notice issue.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases returned for rework are logged with the missing element.
generic.Test population: All terminations approved in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any termination notice was issued before an approval decision was recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing transfer plans cause the case to be returned rather than approved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval accepted when the approver holds authority under the delegation matrix.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management approval record plus the GRC termination entry.

steps.title: Confirm the approver holds authority under the delegation matrix
sop: Read the delegation matrix for the termination type.
Route the approval request to the approver holding that authority.
Record the matrix reference on the approval case.
Done when the request is routed to the authorised approver.
verify: Compare the approver against the delegation matrix for the termination type.
Pass when the approver holds authority for that termination type.

steps.title: Present trigger reason in-force exposure and commission position
sop: Attach the trigger reason, in-force policy and premium exposure to the request.
Attach the outstanding commission and advance balance position.
Summarise the transfer plan status.
Done when all three elements are attached to the approval request.
verify: Open the approval case and check the three attachments.
Pass when the request carries trigger reason, in-force exposure and commission position.

steps.title: Confirm compliance sign-off for for-cause terminations
sop: Check whether the termination is flagged for cause.
Confirm producer compliance sign-off is attached where it is.
Hold the approval where the sign-off is absent.
Done when for-cause terminations carry compliance sign-off.
verify: Query for-cause approvals for a compliance sign-off entry.
Pass when compliance sign-off is recorded for every for-cause termination approval.

steps.title: Return the case for rework where the transfer plan is missing
sop: Check whether a transfer plan exists where in-force business remains.
Return the case for rework rather than approving without one.
Record the rework reason on the case.
Done when cases without a needed transfer plan are returned.
verify: Query approved terminations with in-force business for a transfer plan.
Pass when no termination with in-force business was approved without a transfer plan.

steps.title: Record the approval decision approver and date
sop: Record approve or reject with the rationale on the workflow case.
Record the approver name and decision date.
Mirror the decision to the GRC termination entry.
Done when the decision, approver and date are recorded.
verify: Read the decision entry on the workflow case.
Pass when every termination carries a recorded decision, approver and date.

steps.title: Release the case to notice issue only after approval
sop: Confirm the approval decision is recorded before notice preparation.
Release the case to the notice issue step.
Record the release date on the case.
Done when notice issue is released only after a recorded approval.
verify: Compare notice issue dates against approval decision dates.
Pass when no termination notice was issued before an approval decision was recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: All commission earned, charged back and offset for the terminating producer.
generic.In-scope period: Through the termination effective date plus any vesting entitlement period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Earned commission, chargebacks, offsets, vesting entitlement and payment reference are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Final statement total equals earned commission less chargebacks and offsets.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The final settlement statement is retained with its issue date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Residual debit balances are logged with a recovery plan and owner.
generic.Test population: All commission transactions for the producer through the effective date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any unreconciled debit balance remains open after settlement.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed amounts route to the dispute resolution task before the statement is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Settlement accepted when the statement shows earned commission, chargebacks and offsets.
generic.Evidence location: Billing and commission platform settlement record plus the ERP general ledger posting.

steps.title: Calculate earned commission through the effective date
sop: Extract commissionable transactions through the termination effective date.
Calculate earned commission using the rates in force for each period.
Record the earned total on the settlement working paper.
Done when earned commission through the effective date is calculated.
verify: Recalculate the earned commission from the transaction extract.
Pass when the earned total reproduces from the transaction data.

steps.title: Apply chargebacks for cancelled or lapsed policies
sop: List cancelled and lapsed policies triggering chargeback under the agreement.
Apply the chargeback terms stated in the agreement.
Record each chargeback with its policy reference.
Done when all applicable chargebacks are applied.
verify: Compare applied chargebacks against the agreement chargeback terms.
Pass when every chargeback follows the agreement terms.

steps.title: Offset advances debit balances and unreturned advance commission
sop: Extract outstanding advances and debit balances for the producer.
Offset them against the earned commission position.
Record each offset with its source reference.
Done when all offsets are applied to the settlement.
verify: Compare applied offsets against the outstanding balance extract.
Pass when every outstanding advance and debit balance is offset or scheduled.

steps.title: Honour post-termination renewal or vesting entitlement
sop: Read the vesting and post-termination renewal clause in the agreement.
Calculate any entitlement due after the effective date.
Record the entitlement basis and schedule on the settlement.
Done when any vesting entitlement is calculated and recorded.
verify: Compare the entitlement calculation against the agreement clause.
Pass when any vesting entitlement matches the agreement terms.

steps.title: Issue the final settlement statement to the producer
sop: Compile earned commission, chargebacks, offsets and entitlement into the statement.
Issue the statement to the producer with the issue date recorded.
Attach the statement to the producer record.
Done when the final statement is issued and attached.
verify: Open the issued statement and check the four components.
Pass when a final statement showing earned commission, chargebacks and offsets exists.

steps.title: Post the payment or recovery and clear the balance
sop: Post the net payment or recovery through the commission platform and general ledger.
Record the payment or recovery reference on the settlement.
Log any residual debit balance with a recovery plan.
Done when the settlement is posted and the balance cleared or planned.
verify: Query the producer balance after the settlement posting.
Pass when no unreconciled debit balance remains open for the producer.

generic.Defined scope/population: All orphaned policies left after the producer termination.
generic.In-scope period: From termination effective date to the reassignment target date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy reference, state, line, receiving producer and effective date are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policies reassigned plus policies to direct servicing equal the orphaned population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The receiving producer acceptance is recorded with its date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies with no eligible receiving producer are logged for direct servicing.
generic.Test population: All orphaned policies at the termination effective date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any policy remains in the orphaned queue past the reassignment target date.
generic.Exception handling path: States without an appointed receiving producer route to direct servicing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reassignment accepted when renewal commission follows the receiving producer.
generic.Evidence location: Policy administration system servicing producer field plus the CRM acceptance record.

steps.title: List orphaned policies by state line and renewal date
sop: Extract policies with no active servicing producer after the termination.
Group them by state, line and renewal date.
Record the orphaned population count.
Done when the orphaned policy list is produced.
verify: Re-run the orphan extract and compare the count.
Pass when the orphaned population reproduces from the policy system.

steps.title: Assign each policy to an appointed and licensed producer
sop: Select a receiving producer appointed and licensed for the state and line.
Assign each orphaned policy to that producer.
Route policies with no eligible producer to direct servicing.
Done when every orphaned policy has an assignment decision.
verify: Compare assignments against receiving producer appointments by state and line.
Pass when every assignment matches an appointed and licensed producer.

steps.title: Confirm the receiving producer accepts the servicing responsibility
sop: Contact each receiving producer with the proposed policy list.
Obtain and record acceptance of the servicing responsibility.
Reassign elsewhere where acceptance is declined.
Done when every assignment carries a recorded acceptance.
verify: Query assignments for a missing acceptance record.
Pass when every reassignment carries a receiving producer acceptance.

steps.title: Update the servicing producer code with the effective date
sop: Set the servicing producer code on each policy record.
Set the reassignment effective date on the same update.
Confirm the update applied across all assigned policies.
Done when the servicing producer and effective date are set on every policy.
verify: Query reassigned policies for a blank servicing producer or effective date.
Pass when every reassigned policy carries a servicing producer and effective date.

steps.title: Confirm renewal commission routing follows the reassignment
sop: Test a renewal calculation after the reassignment effective date.
Confirm commission routes to the receiving producer.
Correct the routing where it still points to the terminated code.
Done when renewal commission routes to the receiving producer.
verify: Read the renewal commission routing on a test policy.
Pass when renewal commission routes to the receiving producer from the effective date.

steps.title: Clear the orphaned queue by the target date
sop: Re-run the orphan query at the reassignment target date.
Clear any residual policy through direct servicing assignment.
Record the queue closure date.
Done when the orphaned queue is cleared at the target date.
verify: Read the orphan queue at the target date.
Pass when no policy remains in the orphaned queue past the reassignment target date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open commission disputes for the producer at off-boarding.
generic.In-scope period: From dispute intake to resolution before the settlement is finalised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Disputed amount, recalculated amount, decision authority and communication are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disputes resolved equal open disputes at the start of off-boarding.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The recalculation working and outcome letter are retained with their dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disputes the producer continues to contest are logged with the escalation route.
generic.Test population: All open commission disputes for the terminating producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any open commission dispute remains for a producer set to terminated status.
generic.Exception handling path: Goodwill or write-off decisions apply the resolution authority thresholds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Resolution accepted when recalculated amount, authority and communication are recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Workflow case management dispute record plus the commission platform recalculation.

steps.title: List every open commission dispute for the producer
sop: Query the workflow tool for open commission disputes on the producer.
Include disputes transferred from the open activity closure task.
Record the open dispute count and total disputed amount.
Done when every open dispute is listed before settlement.
verify: Re-run the open dispute query for the producer.
Pass when the dispute list matches the open dispute query result.

steps.title: Recalculate the disputed amount from policy and rate data
sop: Pull the underlying policy and rate data for each disputed item.
Recalculate the commission independently of the producer statement.
Record the recalculated amount on the dispute.
Done when every dispute carries an independent recalculation.
verify: Compare the recalculation source against the producer statement.
Pass when every recalculation derives from policy and rate data, not the statement.

steps.title: Apply the resolution authority thresholds for goodwill or write-off
sop: Determine whether any goodwill payment or write-off is proposed.
Route the decision to the authority level required by the threshold.
Record the decision authority on the dispute.
Done when every goodwill or write-off carries the correct decision authority.
verify: Compare the decision authority against the threshold table.
Pass when every goodwill or write-off decision was taken at the required authority.

steps.title: Communicate the outcome in writing to the producer
sop: Write the outcome letter stating the recalculated amount and the decision.
Send it to the producer and record the send date.
Attach the letter to the dispute record.
Done when the outcome has been communicated in writing.
verify: Open the dispute and read the outcome communication.
Pass when every resolved dispute carries a dated written outcome communication.

steps.title: Record producer acceptance or continued dispute
sop: Request the producer response to the outcome.
Record acceptance or continued dispute on the case.
Escalate continued disputes to the agreed escalation route.
Done when the producer position is recorded on every dispute.
verify: Query resolved disputes for a recorded producer position.
Pass when every resolved dispute records acceptance or continued dispute.

steps.title: Confirm no dispute remains open at terminated status
sop: Re-run the open dispute query before the producer status is set to terminated.
Resolve or formally escalate any remaining dispute.
Record the confirmation on the off-boarding checklist.
Done when no dispute remains open at the point of termination.
verify: Query open disputes for producers in terminated status.
Pass when no open commission dispute remains for a producer set to terminated status.

generic.Defined scope/population: All system access held by the terminated producer and its registered sub-users.
generic.In-scope period: The termination effective date and the period immediately following.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: System, account, revocation timestamp and checklist entry are recorded per revocation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Accounts revoked equal accounts registered under the producer or agency code.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The revocation timestamp per system is recorded on the off-boarding checklist.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts that cannot be revoked immediately are logged with an owner and target time.
generic.Test population: All producer and sub-user accounts at the effective date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any terminated producer or sub-user retains an active login on the effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Post-effective-date logins trigger an immediate security incident review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Revocation accepted when every system carries a recorded revocation timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: IAM platform revocation records plus the off-boarding checklist in the producer system.

steps.title: Disable portal and quoting logins on the effective date
sop: Disable the Broker and Agent Portal login for the producer.
Disable quoting system access through the IAM platform.
Record the disable timestamp per system.
Done when portal and quoting logins are disabled on the effective date.
verify: Attempt an authentication check on the disabled accounts.
Pass when portal and quoting logins are inactive on the effective date.

steps.title: Remove writing authority and binding permissions
sop: Remove writing authority in the producer management system.
Remove binding permissions in the policy administration system.
Record the removal timestamp for each.
Done when writing and binding permissions are removed.
verify: Query the producer for active writing or binding permissions.
Pass when no writing or binding permission remains active.

steps.title: Remove the producer from commission and statement distribution
sop: Remove the producer from commission payment distribution lists.
Remove the producer from statement distribution lists.
Retain the final settlement statement route separately.
Done when the producer is removed from ongoing distribution lists.
verify: Query distribution lists for the terminated producer.
Pass when the producer appears on no ongoing commission or statement list.

steps.title: Revoke access for sub-users under the producer or agency code
sop: List sub-users registered under the producer or agency code in IAM.
Revoke each sub-user account.
Record the revocation per sub-user.
Done when every registered sub-user account is revoked.
verify: Query IAM for active accounts under the producer or agency code.
Pass when no terminated producer or sub-user retains an active login.

steps.title: Record the revocation timestamp per system on the checklist
sop: Write the revocation timestamp for each system to the off-boarding checklist.
Log any system where revocation is delayed with an owner.
Sign the revocation step with a date.
Done when every system revocation timestamp is on the checklist.
verify: Read the checklist revocation lines for missing timestamps.
Pass when every system carries a recorded revocation timestamp.

steps.title: Monitor for post-effective-date logins
sop: Review portal and system login logs after the effective date.
Investigate any login by the producer or a sub-user.
Raise a security incident where a login is found.
Done when the login logs are reviewed after the effective date.
verify: Query the portal login log for the terminated producer after the effective date.
Pass when no portal login occurs for a terminated producer after the effective date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every state in which the producer holds an active carrier appointment.
generic.In-scope period: The notice period required by each state for the termination filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: State, filing date, termination reason code and NIPR confirmation reference are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filings submitted equal states with an active carrier appointment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The NIPR confirmation reference per state is retained with its filing date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States where filing is rejected are logged and refiled with the correction.
generic.Test population: All states with an active appointment for the producer.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any active carrier appointment remains after the filing window closes.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected filings are corrected and resubmitted inside the state notice period.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Filing accepted when the reason code matches the documented termination reason.
generic.Evidence location: NIPR confirmation records plus the regulatory filing and issue tracker entries.

steps.title: List every state with an active carrier appointment
sop: Query the producer management system for active appointments by state.
Cross check against the NIPR appointment position.
Record the state list for filing.
Done when every state with an active appointment is listed.
verify: Compare the state list against the NIPR appointment position.
Pass when the list covers every state with an active carrier appointment.

steps.title: Determine the notice period required by each state
sop: Read the appointment termination notice period for each state.
Set the filing deadline per state from the termination effective date.
Record the deadline on the filing tracker.
Done when a filing deadline is set for every state.
verify: Compare filing deadlines against state notice requirements.
Pass when every state filing deadline matches its state requirement.

steps.title: Submit the appointment termination via NIPR per state
sop: Submit the termination filing through NIPR for each state.
Submit inside the notice period required by that state.
Record the submission date per state.
Done when every state filing has been submitted inside its notice period.
verify: Compare submission dates against state filing deadlines.
Pass when every state filing was submitted inside its notice period.

steps.title: Use the termination reason code required by each state
sop: Map the documented termination reason to each state reason code.
Apply the state code on the filing.
Confirm no filing understates a for-cause reason where the state requires it.
Done when each filing carries the correct state reason code.
verify: Compare filed reason codes against the documented termination reason.
Pass when every filed reason code matches the documented reason.

steps.title: Retain the NIPR confirmation reference per state
sop: Capture the NIPR confirmation reference for each state filing.
Record it against the producer in the regulatory tracker.
Attach the confirmation to the termination record.
Done when a confirmation reference is retained per state.
verify: Query state filings for a missing confirmation reference.
Pass when a NIPR confirmation reference is retained for each state termination filed.

steps.title: Reconcile filings against the appointment list
sop: Compare filed terminations against the active appointment list.
Investigate and refile any state missed or rejected.
Record the reconciliation result.
Done when every appointment state has a completed filing.
verify: Query NIPR for active carrier appointments after the filing window.
Pass when no active carrier appointment remains after the filing window closes.

generic.Defined scope/population: The producer master record for each approved termination.
generic.In-scope period: The approved termination effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Status, effective date, licensing fields and appointment fields are updated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Terminated records equal approved terminations with a served notice.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The status change is retained in the record history with its timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records failing propagation to downstream systems are logged for correction.
generic.Test population: All producer records set to terminated in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any terminated producer still appears in active producer selection lists.
generic.Exception handling path: Propagation failures are corrected at the authoritative source and re-tested.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Update accepted when the record is retained rather than deleted.
generic.Evidence location: Producer management system record history plus the policy administration system status.

steps.title: Set the producer master status to Terminated
sop: Open the producer record in the producer management system.
Set status to Terminated with the approved effective date.
Record the change reason reference.
Done when status is Terminated with the approved effective date.
verify: Read the status and effective date on the producer record.
Pass when producer status is Terminated with the approved effective date recorded.

steps.title: Confirm propagation to policy admin and commission platforms
sop: Check the producer status in the policy administration system after the sync window.
Check the status in the commission platform.
Raise a defect where either has not updated.
Done when the status has propagated to both downstream systems.
verify: Compare the producer status across the three systems.
Pass when the terminated status is consistent across all three systems.

steps.title: Confirm removal from active producer selection lists
sop: Test the producer selection lists in quoting and policy issue screens.
Confirm the terminated producer no longer appears.
Raise a defect where the producer is still selectable.
Done when the producer is absent from active selection lists.
verify: Search the active producer selection list for the terminated producer.
Pass when the terminated producer no longer appears in active selection lists.

steps.title: Retain the record rather than deleting it
sop: Confirm the producer record remains queryable after the status change.
Confirm the history and linked transactions remain intact.
Do not delete or purge the record.
Done when the record is retained with its full history.
verify: Query the terminated producer record and its history.
Pass when the record and its history remain queryable after termination.

steps.title: Update licensing and appointment fields after the NIPR filing
sop: Refresh the licensing and appointment fields after the NIPR terminations are filed.
Confirm the fields reflect the terminated appointment position.
Record the refresh date.
Done when licensing and appointment fields reflect the terminated position.
verify: Compare the appointment fields against the NIPR post-filing position.
Pass when licensing and appointment fields match the NIPR terminated position.

steps.title: Record the status change on the off-boarding checklist
sop: Record the status change date and the systems confirmed on the checklist.
Log any propagation defect with an owner.
Sign the status update step complete.
Done when the status update step is signed on the checklist.
verify: Read the signed status update entry on the off-boarding checklist.
Pass when the checklist records the status change and confirmed downstream systems.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every proposed producer termination requiring grounds validation.
generic.In-scope period: From termination proposal to the approval request being raised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Grounds, evidence sufficiency, approval level, notice and cure assessment are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Validations completed equal terminations proposed in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The validation conclusion, reviewer and date are recorded before approval is sought.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Grounds not supported by the agreement are rejected and logged with the reasoning.
generic.Test population: All terminations proposed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any termination lacks a documented grounds validation with reviewer and date.
generic.Exception handling path: Insufficient for-cause evidence downgrades the termination to a without-cause route.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation accepted when state notice and cure obligations have been assessed.
generic.Evidence location: GRC platform validation record plus the agreement in the document repository.

steps.title: Confirm the stated grounds are permitted by the agreement
sop: Read the termination clause in the producer agreement.
Compare the stated grounds against the permitted termination grounds.
Reject grounds not permitted by the agreement.
Done when the grounds are confirmed permissible or rejected.
verify: Compare the stated grounds against the agreement termination clause.
Pass when every validated termination cites a permitted ground.

steps.title: Confirm evidence is sufficient for a for-cause ground
sop: Review the evidence supporting any for-cause ground.
Assess whether it would withstand challenge.
Downgrade to a without-cause route where evidence is insufficient.
Done when for-cause evidence sufficiency is assessed and recorded.
verify: Read the evidence sufficiency conclusion for for-cause terminations.
Pass when supporting evidence is filed for every for-cause ground asserted.

steps.title: Identify the required approval level for the termination type
sop: Read the delegation matrix for the termination type and ground.
Identify the required approval level.
Record the required approver on the validation.
Done when the required approval level is identified and recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded approval level against the delegation matrix.
Pass when the identified approval level matches the matrix for that termination type.

steps.title: Assess state notice and cure-period obligations
sop: List the states in which the producer is appointed.
Assess the state notice period and any cure-period obligation.
Record the assessment conclusion per state.
Done when notice and cure obligations are assessed for every state.
verify: Read the notice and cure assessment on the validation record.
Pass when state notice and cure obligations have been assessed and recorded.

steps.title: Record the validation conclusion and reviewer
sop: Write the validation conclusion on the GRC record.
Record the reviewer name and the validation date.
Attach the supporting evidence references.
Done when the conclusion, reviewer and date are recorded.
verify: Query terminations for a missing validation conclusion or reviewer.
Pass when each termination carries a documented grounds validation with reviewer and date.

steps.title: Release the case to the approval request
sop: Confirm the validation is complete before the approval request is raised.
Release the case to the leadership approval step.
Record the release date on the validation record.
Done when the approval request follows a completed validation.
verify: Compare the approval request date against the validation date.
Pass when every approval request follows a recorded grounds validation.
